Obulwadde bw’akawuka ka corona akapya (COVID-19), obuleetebwa akawuka ka kolona-2 akakosa omussizo (SARS-CoV-2), mu Afirika bulina ekifaananyi ky’abantu abangi ab’obutalaga bubonero (oba abalina obubonero obutono) abateeberezebwa okuba n’omugaso mu kusaasaanya obuwuka.
Omuwendo ogwennyini n’obuzito bw’obulwadde bw’abantu abatalaga bubonero bikyali tebimanyiddwa bulungi.
Okunoonyereza kyokka kulaga nti obukulembeze bwabwe bukulu nnyo mu kugonjoola okusaasaana kwa SARS-CoV-2.

Twakola omutetenkanyirizo ogw’ebyafaayo ogwanguwa ogw’okutunuulira abantu abayinza okukwatibwa obulwadde, abali mu mbeera y’okukwatibwa, ekisiiga n’abaggyiddwa (SEIR) okusobola okwekeneenya engeri y’okwawulamu abantu abakwata SARS-CoV-2 naye nga balina obutalaga bubonero nga tukozesa okukebera kwonna okumalawo ensaasaanya mu Lusaka Province e Zambia.

Ku mutetenkanyirizo ogutwala nti ebitundu 70% by’abantu tebalaga bubonero, omuwendo ogutaleka ku lunaku ogw’okukebera abantu obutereevu oguli waggulu ku ≥ 7911 enkebera/100000 abantu gwali gumala okulwanyisa okubalukawo singa abantu abatalaga bubonero baba nga basiiga ekitundu ekimu kyokka, ate singa obulwadde bwetwalibwa nti buli kimu, omuwendo ogw’okukebera oguli waggulu ku ≥ 10028 enkebera/100000 abantu gwandibadde gwetaagisa.

Ku 50% obutalaga bubonero, omuwendo ogutono ogw’okukebera abantu bonna ogwa ≥ 4540 enkebera/ 100000 abantu gwali gumala okulwanyisa okubalukawo ku mutendera gyonna ogw’obulwadde obutalaga bubonero ku bantu abatalaga bubonero nga gusinga ku bantu abalina obubonero.
Okukubaganya ebirowoozo n’okukubira

Omutetenkanyirizo gwaffe gubikkula nti okweyawula kw’abantu abalina COVID-19, omuli n’abo abatalaga bubonero, okuyita mu kukebera kwonna kuyinza okukozesebwa ng’ekkubo erisoboka mu kulwanyisa okusaasaana kwa SARS-Cov-2 mu Lusaka, Zambia, naye kijja kuba n’ensimbi nnyingi.
Okukebera okwa bonna mu bibuga binene nga Lusaka kuyinza okukendeeza ku kusaasaana kwa COVID-19, naye ekyo kisoboka okukola?

Mu 2020, emitetenkanyirizo gya kompyuta gyateebereza nti ensaasaana ya COVID-19 mu bibuga binene eyinza okukugibwa bulungi nga bakozesa okukebera abantu bangi, era oluvannyuma ne basigaza bokka abaalabibwa nga balina obulwadde.
Wabula, abanoonyereza bagamba nti enkola eno eyinza okuba ya buseere era nga tekolebeka.
Ku ntandikwa ya nawookeera, abantu bangi abaakwatibwa COVID-19 tebaalaga bubonero bwa kirwadde naye ne bakyasasaanya kirwadde eri abalala.

Ebimu ku by’okunoonyereza byalaga nti abantu abali wakati wa 50% ne 80% abaalina COVID-19 tebaalina bubonero (obutalaga bubonero) era bayinza okuba nga be baali n’ebivunaanyizibwa ku 40% okutuuka ku 70% y’obuwuka obuggya.
Abanoonyereza baayagala okumanya oba okuzuula n’okwawulamu abantu abatali balaga bubonero kyandiyambye mu kugonjoola okusaasaana kwa COVID-19.
Era baayagala okumanya oba banket-testing, ekitegeeza okukebera abantu bangi mu ngeri etategeerekeka, kisobola okuzuula abantu abali obutalaga bubonero.
Abanoonyereza baakola omutetenkanyirizo gwa kompyuta oguteebereza engeri abantu gye bayinza okuva ku kubeera nga bayinza okukwatibwa ne batuuka okukwatagana, okukwatibwa, n’okutwalibwa mu kkomera.
Baatunuulira obubaka okuva mu kitundu kya Lusaka mu Zambia, ekifo ekikulu ekikola emirimu n’ennyonyi enkulu ey’ensi yonna ekiriraanye amawanga abiri.

Kubanga engeri COVID-19 gy’eyoleka zaali zikyuka okuva mu kifo okudda mu kifo, baalaba ku mbeera 4, nga ebitundu 50% oba 70% by’abalwadde ba COVID-19 tebaalina bubonero, era nga abalwadde bano baali basaasanya ekisiiga mu ngeri y’emu oba mu bitundu ebikyaamu nga bwe kiba eri abalina obubonero.

Omutetenkanyirizo gw’abanoonyereza gwazuula nti kyali kisoboka okwekuuma okusaasaana kwa COVID-19 nga bakola okukebera abantu bonna awamu n’okweyawula abantu bonna abazuuliddwaamu obulwadde, n’abo abatalina bulwadde bulabika.
Baagamba nti okusobola okukendeeza ku bungi bw’abalwadde abasinga obungi n’ebitundu 90% mu mbeera zonna, abantu 10% mu Lusaka baali beetaaga okukeberebwa buli lunaku.
Era baasanga nti singa twagala okukuuma omuwendo gw’obuwuka bwa COVID-19 obupya nga tegukyuka, abantu 22% baalina okukeberebwa buli lunaku.
Newankubadde Zambia yateekawo ebikolebwa bingi mu kukendeeza ku COVID-19, omuwendo gw’abantu abakwatiddwa akawuka kyali nga gukyeyongera.
Okukeberebwa kw’abantu bonna kyakendeeza omuwendo gw’abantu abazuulwamu COVID-19 n’ebitundu 90% mu kibuga kitono mu Italy.
Wabula, tewali kunoonyereza kwonna okw’emabega okulaga nti kyandibadde kikola bulungi mu kibuga kinene ekirala.

Kijjukire nti abanoonyereza tebaakola ku kukebera kwonna mu kunoonyereza kuno; wabula baatondawo omutetenkanyirizo ogulaga nti okukola kukebera kwonna kyandikola okukendeeza okusaasaana kwa COVID-19 mu bibuga ebikulu.
Wabula baalabula nti kiyinza okuba nga kijja kuba kya buseere nnyo.
Era baagamba nti kiyinza okuba eky’omugaso singa kigattibwa ku nkola endala, nga omuggalo, okunoonya abantu ababaddeko n’abalwadde, n’okugema.
Abanoonyereza okuva e Zambia era baateekateeka nti obutalaga bubonero bwa COVID-19 bwali nga businga okuba obwabulijjo mu Afirika mu kiseera ekyo.
Okutereeza okutono kw’ebiteeberezo ebiva mu ndagabutonde ezitali zimu mu bantu b’omu Afirika olw’enjawulo mu ndagabutonde n’eby’obutonde.
Abantu abasibuka mu Afirika tebakiikirirwa bulungi mu kunoonyereza ku ndagabutonde naye balina enjawulo ennyingi mu ndagabutonde era basanga obutafaananako mu bintu ebikolebwa mu nsi yonna.

Kubanga okwekebejja okw’enkola ku bintu ebiteeberezebwa ku ndagabutonde tekwali kukolebwa mu bika ebikwata ku njawulo mu Afirika, twabalirira obubonero obulaga obulabe obw’endagabutonde (PRS) mu bigezo ebikolebwa mu Afirika yonna ne mu bubaka obuva mu South Afirika, Uganda, ne UK okulaba engeri okunoonyereza ku ndagabutonde gye kuyinza okukozesebwa mu ngeri esingako.
Obutufu bwa PRS bukyuka bulungi nga bakozesa ebibinja eby’okunoonyereza ebifaanagana mu buzaale okusinga ebikolebwa ku bantu abatali bafaanagana mu buzaale.
Mu bantu ab’enjawulo mu byafaayo n’eby’obufuzi mu South Afirika, tukizuula nti obutuufu bwa PRS buba wansi ku bubonero bwonna naye buba n’enjawulo mu bibinja.
Enjawulo mu bajjajja b’Abafrika zongera ku njawulo mu bwesige bwa PRS okusinga enjawulo endala ez’omu bibinja binene ezitunuuliddwa wakati w’abantu abali mu UK ne Uganda.

Twasalawo PRS mu bantu ab’ensibuko ya Afirika nga tukozesa okunoonyereza ku ndagabutonde okw’abazungu bokka okusinga okw’enjawulo mu nsibuko; enjawulo eyeyongedde yaleeta okweyongera okw’obulungi mu bungi bwa puloteyini ya sukaali n’omuwendo gwa maselo g’omusaayi omyufu, nga kiraga enjawulo ez’enjawulo mu ndagabutonde mu ndagabutonde ezimanyiddwa okuba n’akakwate ku sickle cell anemia n’okuddamu kw’omubiri ku by’obulabe, buli kimu.

Enjawulo mu bukkakkamu bwa PRS mu bantu abava mu Afirika abava mu bitundu eby’enjawulo ziri nnene nga bwe ziri mu bantu abava ku migabo egy’ebweru wa Afirika, nga kino kyetaaga okwetegereza okw’enjawulo.
Lwaki tetusobola kutuukiriza bulungi okuteebereza endwadde z’endagabutonde mu bantu abava mu Afirika
Abanoonyereza bagamba nti engeri ezikozesebwa mu kiseera kino okulagula oba omuntu ajja kufuna obulwadde obw’endabutonde tezikola bulungi ku bantu abava mu Bulaaya.
Kino kiva ku nsonga nti obubaka obuli emabega w’eby’okulabula ebyo businga okwogera ku ndagabutonde z’abantu abava mu Bulaaya.
Obubaka bwa GWAS buvvuunulwa nga “Okunoonyereza ku Bikola Endagabutonde Ebyawamu”, era abasayansi babukozesa okunoonya ebika n’endwadde nga basinziira ku ndagabutonde.
Mu butuufu, basobola okukozesa GWAS okubalirira obulabe bw’endagabutonde omuntu bw’alina eri obulwadde oba ekika.
Naye obubaka bw’endagabutonde obusinga mu GWAS buva mu bantu abava mu Bulaaya.

Mu kunoonyereza kuno, abanoonyereza baayagala okulaba engeri obubalo bwe bakozesa okusalawo obulabe bw’endwadde eziva ku ndagabutonde nga bakozesa GWAS gye bukolera ku bantu abava mu nsibuko y’Abafrika.
Baayagala n’okulaba oba okunoonyereza kwa GWAS okuli n’enjawulo, mu bigambo ebirala obubaka obulimu obubaka obw’endabutonde obw’Abafrika obungi, kyandiyambye mu kwongera okutegeera ebyo ebiragulwa.
Okubala kuno kumanyiddwa mu bigambo eby’ebyobuyinza ng’ “polygenic risk score”, oba PRS.

Baakozesa kompyuta okubalirira ebizibu ebiteeberezebwa eby’endagabutonde eby’abantu Abafirika nga bakozesa GWAS, era baakozesa ebiwandiiko by’ebyobulamu eby’abantu Abafirika okulaba ku bubonero obumu oba endwadde ezandiba nga zava mu nkyukakyuka mu ndagabutonde.
Bwe bakozesa GWAS ey’omu Bulaaya, baazuula nti omuwendo gw’obulabe ku ndagabutonde gwali gusinga obutuufu singa abantu baali n’obuzadde bwa Bulaaya okusinga obuzadde bwa Afirika ku bintu bingi.
Baagamba nti obubonero obulaga obulabe buba bukyali wansi wakati mu bitundu by’Afirika olw’okuba waliwo enjawulo nnyingi mu bantu, ekitali kyenkana n’ebyo bye tulaba ku bantu ab’omu Bulaaya.
Era baagamba nti obutuufu bwa PRS bukula nga ensibuko y’omu Afirika ekendeera.
Abantu abava mu Ethiopia baalina obuteebereza obulungi ku ndwadde z’endagabutonde kubanga mu ndagabutonde bafaanagana nnyo n’abantu abava mu Bulaaya.
Bw'okozesa GWAS erimu abantu abava mu Afirika, obuteebereza bweyongera okuba obulungi.
Okuteebereza endwadde z’ensigo kyali kya butuufu nnyo.
Okunoonyereza okw’edda kulaze nti PRS eri wansi ku bantu Abafirika, kitegeeza nti obubaka bwa GWAS bulagula obulabe obutono bw’endwadde ez’ekika ky’endagabutonde ku bantu abava mu Afirika.
Naye tumanyi nti kino si kituufu bulijjo.

Okunoonyereza kuno kulaga nti ebibalo ebya wansi eby’obulwadde obw’endagabutonde biva ku kuba nti endagabutonde z’Abafirika teziweereddwa kitiibwa mu bubaka bwa GWAS, era n’olwekyo omuwendo gwa PRS oguliwo kati teguyamba ddala mu kubuulira endwadde z’endagabutonde mu Afirika.
Abanoonyereza bagamba nti kyandibadde kirungi okukozesa obubaka obw’enjawulo obulimu obubaka ku ndagabutonde okuva mu bantu abava mu Afirika.

N’olwekyo, waliwo omulimu ogw’okukola okwongera okunoonyereza kwa GWAS okuteekamu obuwangwa bwa Bafirika, tusobole okuteebereza obulungi engeri endwadde z’endagabutonde gye ziyinza okuba ku bantu ba Bafirika.
Abawandiisi b’okunoonyereza kuno baali bava mu Afirika, USA ne Bungereza.
Okwekenneenya Okusunsula okw’Okulaba n’Okwa Sayitoloji mu Kwewala Obulwadde bwa Cervical Intraepithelial Neoplasia n’Kookolo w’Omumwa gwa Nabaana mu Namibia
Kikakibwa nti abakazi 851,340 mu Namibia bali mu bulabe bw’obuwuka bwa HPV obusobola okuviirako kookolo w’omumwa gwa nabaana.
Okusunsula okulabika n’amasavu ga acetic acid (VIA) n’okujjanjaba n’obutiti byazuuliddwa nga bikola bulungi nnyo.
Naye nga obubaka obw’omukwatagana n’ennukuta y’enteekateeka z’okukebera kookolo w’omumwa gwa nabaana tebuliwo.
Okunoonyereza kuno kwatunuulira okusunsula okw’okulaba n’okukozesa cytology mu kuziyiza obulwadde bw’omumwa gwa nabaana obutali bulungi (CIN) ne kookolo w’omumwa gwa nabaana mu Namibia.
Ebyazuulibwa byalaga nti abakyala abalina akawuka ka HPV, cervicitis, koilocytosis n’atypia balina obulabe obw’enjawulo obw’okufuna ebigezo ebiraga nti balina VIA.
Abakyala abakulu, naddala abalina HIV, basinga okufuna obubonero bwa squamous cell carcinoma (SCC).
Enkola ya VIA erabika ng’eyinza okukola mu kusunsula, newankubadde colposcopy mu kugoberera abalwadde mu mbeera ya Namibia erina okukyusibwa era n’eyambisibwa n’ebivudde mu HR-HPV ebirungi.
Enkola z’okusunsula ezirimu okukebera HPV ku myaka egy’enjawulo n’ebibinja eby’obulabe (ng’abalina HIV, obulwadde obulumba obusibage) ziteesebwako.

Okukeberwa kuyinza okwongera okulongoosebwa okuyita mu nkola ezikozesa omutetenkanyirizo ogukozesa ebyava mu kukebera eby’edda, ebigendererwa by’ebyobulamu by’abakazi, okumanya okw’omulembe n’enkola ekwatagana n’ensonga z’eggwanga.
Abakyala ba Namibia abali mu bulabe bwa kookolo w’omumwa gwa nabaana basaanye okwekebezebwa n’okujjanjabibwa amangu.
Waliwo ebigezo bingi ebiyinza okulaga obulabe bw’abakyala eri kookolo w’omumwa gwa nabaana, naye okwekebeza okwabulijjo mu Namibia tekikozesa bulijjo ebigezo bino.
Abanoonyereza bateesa nti okukebera emirundi egisookerwako, okusobola okuzuula obubonero obw’akaboni nga bukyali, kisobola okuziyiza abakazi obutafuna endwadde eno ey’akabi.
Kookolo w’omumwa gwa nabaana (kookolo w’ekitundu ekya wansi eky’omu lubuto) y’ensonga lwaki abakyala bangi bafa mu nsi yonna.
Emu ku nsonga ezisinga okukosa kookolo w’omumwa gwa nabaana kwe kuba n’akawuka ka Human Papillomavirus oba HPV.
HPV ky’akawuka akalumya obutaffaali bw’omu lubuto, ne kafuula ebiwundu ebiyitibwa lesions, ebyinza okufuuka kookolo.
Newankubadde waliwo eddagala erigema akawuka ka HPV, abakazi bangi mu mawanga ga Afirika, nga Namibia, tebalifuna.
Kino kitegeeza nti okukebera akawuka oba ebiwundu bye kaleeta kikulu nnyo eri abakazi bano, kubanga kye kimu ku ngeri esinga obulungi ey’okuyamba okwewala kookolo.
Abanoonyereza mu kunoonyereza kuno bagamba nti amalwaliro kyekyo galina okufuna ebiragiro ebituufu n’amawulire ku kukebera okusinga obulungi okukozesa.
Baayongerako nti n’abakozi b’ebyobulamu nabo beetaaga obubaka obulala ku ngeri ebintu nga emyaka oba obulamu bwe bikwata ku bukyamu bw’omukazi okufuna HPV ne kookolo.
Baakola okunoonyereza ku ngeri ebimu ku bika by’ebikozesebwa ebisunsula ebisookerwako (ebiyitibwa engeri z’okusunsula) gye byali nga bikola mu kuzuula HPV n’ebiwundu.
Mu ngeri endala era baali banyumirwa okugeraageranya enkola z’okusunsula, nga ekyokulabirako nga bakung’aanya ensigo okuva mu lubuto okuzuula obuzibu nga bagerageranya n’okunoonya bika.
Era baayagala okumanya oba enjawulo wakati w’abakazi, gamba ng’emyaka gyabwe, oba nga balina endwadde endala nga HIV, zikyusa emikisa gyabwe egy’okufuna HPV ne kookolo.
Okumanya obubaka buno kuyinza okuyamba amalwaliro n’ebibiina by’obujjanjabi okukozesa engeri z’okusunsula mu ngeri etuufu.
Abanoonyereza baalaba ku biwandiiko by’abalwadde 214 abakyala abaali bakangavuddwa era ne bajjanjabibwa ku HPV, ebiwundu, ne kookolo w’omumwa gwa nabaana mu ddwaliro e Windhoek, Namibia.
Baateeka essira ddala ku kookolo w’omumwa gwa nabaana oguli mu ntandikwa, nga bwe kiba nti endwadde eno esobola okujjanjabibwa mu ngeri eyangu era ey’omugaso.
Baakuŋŋaanya n’obubaka obulala ku myaka gya buli mukyala, awamu n’obulamu bwe obwa bulijjo.

Bwe baakebera ebiwandiiko bino, baazuula nti engeri ez’enjawulo ez’okusunsula emirundi mingi zawa ab’ebyobulamu obubaka obutali bumu, era nti ziyinza okuba ez’omugaso nnyo nga akawuka ka HPV tekannafuuka kookolo oba nga kaakafuuka.
Okugeza, kookolo kyazuulibwanga emirundi mingi nga bakung’aanya era ne banoonyereza ku maselo g’omu lubuto.
Naye nga ebizigiro, kisoboka okuzuulibwa nga okozesa okukeberebwa okw’amaaso, nga okozesa enkola eyitibwa “okukeberebwa okw’amaaso n’ecetic acid” (VIA).
Ekiganyulo ky'akakodyo kano kiri nti kiyamba abasawo okuzuula ebiwundu mu bwangu era mu buseere.
Kino kiva ku nti kikozesa ebikozesebwa eby’obusawo eby’omutindo ebikozesebwa dda mu kukebera abakazi eby’obusawo, nga speculum (ekikozesebwa eky’ekyuma ekikozesebwa okulaba munda mu nsigo).
Era baazuula nti okukozesa enkola ez’enjawulo emirundi mingi kyawanga abasawo obubaka obusingawo ku bulabe bw’omukazi okufuna kookolo, naddala mu kwekebeza emirundi mingi.

Era, abanoonyereza baazuula nti abakyala abakulu, naddala abo abalina HIV, bebalina obusobozi obusinga okuzuulibwa nga balina kookolo, n’olwekyo okubakebera emirundi mingi kisobola okuba eky’amaanyi ennyo.
Abanoonyereza baayongerako nti abakazi batono nnyo abeekeberebwa HPV (nga tebannanoonya bizinga) newankubadde ekikemo kibawo.
Okukikola kiyinza okuba engeri ya muwendo ey’okuzuula endwadde eno n’okusingawo.

Mu ngeri yonna, baagamba nti ebyava mu kunoonyereza kwabwe byalaga nti waliwo obwetaavu eri enkola y’ebyobulamu mu Namibia okulowooza ku nteekateeka z’okulwanyisa HPV ne kookolo w’omumwa gwa nabaana n’obwegendereza, nga bakozesa engeri ez’ebbeeyi entono era ezikola obulungi okukeberebwa endwadde zino nga bwe zikyali mu ntandikwa.
Okunoonyereza kwakolebwa bannassaayansi okuva e Namibia ne South Africa.
Obuyinza bw’okujjanjaba mu bantu abalina obuwuka bwa HBV/HIV bw’ogeraageranya n’abo abalina obuwuka bwa HBV bokka mu kibinja ky’abantu mu South Afirika

Nga tukubirizibwa ebiruubirirwa eby’ensi yonna eby’okumalawo akawuka ka hepatitis B (HBV), twatandika okutegeera abantu abalina obuwuka bwa HBV bokka n’abo abali n’obuwuka bwa HBV/HIV, okusobola okwekaliriza engeri y’okujjanjaba n’okukulembera okuteekateeka okunoonyereza mu kujjanjaba.

Tuwaddeyo obubaka obw’okulabirako okuva mu kibinja ekya nsi yonna eky’abantu abakulu 115 abali n’obuwuka bwa hepatitis B obw’ekiseera ekiwanvu (CHB), mu ddwaliro ly’eyunivasite mu Cape Town, South Africa.
Okufuna HIV mu kiseera ky’ekimu kwaliwo mu bantu 39 (34%).
Tuwandiika obubaka obw’ekiseera ekimpi ebikwata ku balwadde, eby’obujjanjabi n’eby’ekyuma.

Bwe ggeraageranya n’abo abalina obuwuka bwa HIV, abantu abakulu abali n’obuwuka bwa HBV bokka baali tebasobola kuba HBeAg-positive (p=0.01), tebasobola kuba nga baakolebwa ku elastography (p<0.0001), era tebasobola kuba ku ddagala ly’obuwuka (p<0.0001); baali basobola okuba n’obubonero bwa HBV viraemia (p=0.04), era basobola okuba n’obubonero bw’obulwadde bw’ekibumba nga thrombocytopaenia ey’ekitundu/ey’amaanyi (p=0.007), bilirubin ey’ekitundu (p=0.004), n’obubonero bwa APRI obw’ekitundu (p=0.02).
Embeera ssatu ez’okookolo w’ekibumba zonna zaava mu HBV obuwuka obwokka.

Obubaka bwaffe bulaga nti abantu abalina obuwuka bwa HBV bokka bayinza okuba n’obuzibu okusinga abo abalina obuwuka bwa HIV, nga bulaga obutali bwenkanya obuyinza okubaawo mu kutumibwa, okukebera n’okujjanjaba.
Abanoonyereza bawa obulagirizi okwongera ku bujjanjabi bwa hepatitis B
Mu kunoonyereza kwa mangu ddala, abanoonyereza baasobola okulaga engeri obuwuka bwa hepatitis B (HBV) n'akawuka ka HIV bwe biyinza okuwa obujjanjabi obusinga obuwuka bwa HBV bwokka.
Mu bukiikakkono bwa Afirika, obuwuka obw’ekiseera ekiwanvu obuli ne HBV ne HIV kizibu kinene.
Abasawo beetaaga okutegeera engeri akawuka kano n’eddagala erikakozesebwa okujjanjaba bwe bikolaganamu, basobole okukebera obulungi n’okujjanjaba abalwadde.
Abanoonyereza baayagala okugeraageranya engeri obujjanjabi gye bukosa abalwadde abaalina HBV yokka, n’abalwadde abaalina HBV wamu ne HIV.
Mu kunoonyereza kuno, abanoonyereza baafunira abalwadde abakulu 115 abalina obuwuka bwa hepatitis B ow’olukonziba (CHB).
Baafunibwa okuva mu ddwaliro lya Tygerberg mu Cape Town, South Africa.
Abamu ku balwadde baali balina HIV (39) ate abalala baali balina HBV yokka.
Abanoonyereza baatunuulira enzikiriza, emyaka n’ekikula, era ne bakola ebigezo eby’enjawulo eby’ebyobulamu n’eby’omu labu.

Baazuula nti abalwadde abaalina HBV bokka baali tebasobola kuba ku ngeri yonna y’eddagala ly’obuwuka, nga balaga obubonero obw’obutonde obw’endwadde y’ekibumba (kubanga HBV ky’akawuka akayinza okuleeta endwadde y’ekibumba ennyingi).

Abanoonyereza baasobola okulaga nti abantu abalina HBV bokka baali mu mbeera embi bwe baagerageranyizibwa n’abo abaalina HIV ne HBV, kubanga abalwadde abaalina obuwuka bw’akawuka kombi baali basobola okuba ku ddagala ly’obuwuka lya HIV, era nga lino lyaweereza obuyambi mu kulwanyisa obuwuka bwa HBV.

Ebyava mu kunoonyereza kuno biraga engeri enjawulo wakati w’okuweereza, okukebera n’enkola z’obujjanjabi ku HBV bwe ziri bw’ogeraageranya ku HIV n’obuwuka bwa HBV, ekiraga obulungi abo abalina obuwuka bwa HIV ne HBV.
Abanoonyereza baalaze nti kituufu twetaaga okuteekateeka n’okuwa obuweereza obulungi era obwenkanya eri abalwadde abali n’obulwadde bwa HBV bokka.
Ekikugira ekimu mu kunoonyereza kuno kwe kuba ng’ekibinja ky’abantu kye kyali kitono era nga kyali kikwata ku ggwanga limu lyokka n’enkola y’amalwaliro gaabwe.
Ebimu ku bifo by’eddwaliro ebiyinza okuba nga bituukiridde ennyo biyinza okulaga endowooza enkyamu bwe bigenyerezebwa ku ebyazuulibwa mu kunoonyereza kuno.
Okunoonyereza okw’enjawulo kwetaaga okukolebwa okuzuula ddala enjawulo ezasangibwa mu kunoonyereza kuno.
Ekiwandiiko kino kyayolesa amaanyi g’omukago, nga abanoonyereza bakola ku mulimu guno okuva mu South Africa ne mu Mukago gwa Bungereza.
Nga bakozesa abantu abalwadde abava mu South Africa mu kunoonyereza kuno, kikwatagana n’ekitundu ky’abantu b’Afirika.
Era, okunoonyereza kuno kuyinza okuyamba mu kukulaakulanya enteekateeka z’obujjanjabi ezisingawo obulungi eri abo abalina obuzibu bwa HBV, HIV oba byombi.
Okwekenneenya Ekyukakyuka ky’Obutebenkevu ku Bikolwa by’Obusuubuzi bw’Abakazi mu Kitundu kya Gavumenti y’Ekibuga ekya SHIRORO mu Disitulikiti ya Niger

Okunoonyereza kuno kwetegereza engeri obutebenkevu gye bweyingiramu mu bikolwa by’obusuubuzi eby’abakazi mu kitundu kya Gavumenti y’Ekibuga Shiroro mu Disitulikiti ya Niger, nga kisinziira ddala ku nsonga ezikwata ku kwesigama kw’abakazi ku by’ensimbi, engeri y’ebikolwa by’obusuubuzi ebisinga okuba obulijjo mu bbo, n’enkola y’engeri obutebenkevu gye bweyingiramu mu mirimu gyabwe egy’obusuubuzi.
Sampolo y’abakazi 377 yanoonyerezebwako, era ne kivaamu okuzuula nti abakazi mu Shiroro balina obusobozi obw’amaanyi mu by’obusuubuzi nga balina obwetwaze mu by’ensimbi, era nga bakola nnyo mu SME.

Okunoonyereza era kwalaba nti newankubadde obutebenkevu bulina obulabe ku bikolwa by’abakyala eby’obusuubuzi mu ngeri y’okufiirwa oba okukendeera kw’ensimbi awamu n’ebintu ebirala, omuwendo gw’abakyala abasuubuzi tegukosebwa nnyo.

Okunoonyereza kwateesa nti pulogulaamu ez’ensibo ez’okutumbula ennyingiza y’abakyala n’okukozesa eby’obugagga by’ensimbi zisaanye okuteekebwawo era n’ebitongole by’okukuuma ddembe mu bitundu nabyo bissaanye okuteekebwawo era n’okunywezebwa okulwanyisa obutebenkevu mu kitundu ekyo eky’okunoonyereza.
Abakazi abakola bizinensi mu Niger beetaaga obukuumi obusingawo

Abanoonyereza baazuula nti abakazi abakola bizinensi mu Niger balina obusobozi obw’amaanyi mu by’obusuubuzi era nga beeyimiridde mu by’ensimbi, naye obutebenkevu okuva mu bamenyi b’amateeka ky’ensonga.

Abanoonyereza baayagala okumanya obulungi n’obukuumi bw’abakazi abakola emirimu mu kitundu kya Shiroro mu Gavumenti y’Ekitundu eya Niger, era n’engeri kino gye kiyinza okukosa emirimu gyabwe n’obwetwaze bwabwe mu by’ensimbi.
Baabuuza abakyala 377 mu kitundu kino ku bizibu bye basanga mu mirimu gyabwe egy’obusuubuzi, obwesige bw’ebyensimbi n’obutali bulungi.
Baategeeza nti ebitundu 43% eby’abakazi baagamba nti tebaali beesigamye ku basajja ku nsimbi, ate ebitundu 32% baagamba nti baalina abantu abalala ababeesigamako ku nsimbi.
Abanoonyereza era baazuula nti ebitundu 85% eby’abakazi baali bafuna ssente okuva mu bizinensi ez’enjawulo, ate abamu bokka be baagamba nti baali beesigama ku musaala.
Ebitundu 56% baafuna ssente okuyita mu kulima, ate ebitundu 79% okuyita mu kutunda.
Nga omukyala omu ku bataano yafunanga ensimbi ng’akola ku misono gy’enviiri, okusiba, okukola obutimba oba okukola ku by’okwoza engoye.
Abakyala abasinga obungi (91%) baategeeza abanoonyereza nti emirimu gyabwe gyakosebwa olw’okutya okubateebereza ababbii n’abamenyi b’amateeka.
Bafiirwa ssente era n’abasajja baabwe olw’okubateebereza, oluusi kibasobozesa okubeerera abaana baabwe bokka.
Abakazi era baagamba nti tebaalina bumenyi bumala na ssente z’okugaziya emirimu gyabwe.
Abanoonyereza baategeeza nti newankubadde nga waliwo ezo ensonga, abakazi b’e Niger baakyalina okukola obulungi mu mirimu gyabwe.
Baagamba nti Shiroro yalina abantu abava mu mawanga ag’enjawulo n’eddiini ez’enjawulo, era kino kyali kirungi ku by’obusuubuzi.
Okunoonyereza kuno kulwanyisa ebyazuulibwa by’abanoonyereza abalala abategeeza nti abakazi balina obuwanguzi obutono mu by’obusuubuzi olw’okuba nga be bajjanjabi awaka.
Naye, abanoonyereza bano bagamba nti obuwanguzi bw’abakazi abakola bizinensi mu kitundu kino ky’e Niger bukoseddwa nnyo obulabe obuva mu kutulugunyizibwa abamenyi b’amateeka n’ababbi.
Abanoonyereza baateesa nti abakwatibwako bonna balina okujja wamu balwanyise ebintu ebiyinza okuleetera obuzibu mu kufuna obuwanguzi mu by’obusuubuzi.
Ng’ekyokulabirako, abakazi mu Niger basaanye bafune obuyambi obusingawo, ebibanja n’obukuumi.
Era baateesa nti abakazi mu byabizineesi basobola okutondawo ebibiina ebiyinza okubayamba okulwanyisa ababbi n’abamenyi b’amateeka.
Obungi bw’ekikomo, seleniyamu ne zinki mu lusaayisaayi lwa maama ng’ali lubuto bikwatagana n’obulabe bw’okuzaala omwana atannatuuka: Okunoonyereza kwa case-control okuva e Malawi
Okuzaala omwana atannatuuka kwe kuzaala nga wiiki 37 tezinnaggwa.
Okunoonyereza kwakoleddwa okulaba enkolagana wakati w’ebigero by’omusaayi gwa bamaama obuliamu seleniyamu, ekikomo, ne zinki, n’okuzaala omwana atannatuuka.
Waliwo abakazi 181 mu kunoonyereza kuno okw’okugeraageranya okuli mu nkola ey’okuteeka mu bifo eby’enjawulo, 90/181 (49.7%) abali embuto ezituuse n’abakazi 91/181 (50.3%) abali embuto ezitannatuuka.

Omukkati gw’obungi bwa seleniyamu mu lusaayisaayi gwali 77.0; SD 19.4µg/L, ekikomo kyali 2.50; SD 0.52 mg/L ate zinki yali 0.77; SD 0.20 mg/L nga miwendo egijulizibwako giri 47-142µg/L, 0.76-1.59mg/L ne 0.59-1.11 mg/L, mu nziriŋŋana eyo.
Ebyavaamu biraga nti tewaaliwo kubulwa kwa seleniyamu, ne zinki; era nga waliwo obungi obuwanvu bwa lusaayisaayi ya ekikomo mu mbeera y’obuto.
Okuzaala omwana atannatuuka kyali kyegattiddwa n’ebigero ebya waggulu eby’ekikomo ne zinki mu lusaayisaayi lwa maama.
Ebigero bya zinki, ekikomo, ne seleniyamu ebigattibwa n’okuzaala omwana atannatuuka
Abanoonyereza baazuula obungi obusingako bw’ebiriisa seleniyamu, ekikomo, ne zinki mu bakyala abaazaala omwana atannatuuka, naye bakyali tebamanyi oba obungi buno buva mu mmere gye balya.
Okuzaala omwana atannatuuka kibaawo omukyala bw’azaala nga tannamala wiiki 37 z’olubuto.
Okuzaala omwana atannatuuka kuyungibwa n’ebiva ku mbeera mbi z’obulamu eri omwana okuva ku nsobi mu kuzaalibwa okutuuka ku kufa.
Waliwo ebintu bingi ebiyinza okuleetera okuzaala omwana atannatuuka, naye obuvunaanyizibwa bw’ebiriisa ebiri mu bungi obusangibwa mu mmere n’obutonde tebimanyiddwa bulungi.
Ebiriiisa bino bikulu nnyo mu nkula y’omwana, naye abanoonyereza baagala okumanya ekibaawo singa biba bingi nnyo.

Mu kunoonyereza kuno, abanoonyereza baalina ekigendererwa okukebera obungi bwa seleniyamu, ekikomo, ne zinki mu bakyala abaazaala abaana abatanatuuka, era ne balondoola emikisa egy’okuba nti okuzaala omwana atannatuuka kiva ku bungi obusinga obwa buli kimu ku biriisa ebyanoonyerezebwako.
Abanoonyereza baakuŋŋaanya sampolo z’omusaayi okuva ku bakyala 181 amangu ddala nga bamaze okuzaala mu malwaliro abiri mu Lilongwe, ekibuga ekikulu ekya Malawi, wakati wa June 2016 ne March 2017.
Baawereza sampolo z’omusaayi mu kkeberero mu Norway gye baaggyayo lusaayisaayi, ekika ekirongoofu ky’omusaayi, era ne bapima obungi bwa seleniyamu, ekikomo ne zinki.
Nga kitundu kya bakyala 181 abali mu kunoonyereza kuno baazaala abaana abatannatuuka, era abanoonyereza baasanga obungi bwa seleniyamu, ekikomo ne zinki obwali waggulu nnyo.

Bwe batyo ne baggyako eby’okubala byabwe okulaba ku nsonga endala nnyingi nga emyaka, obulamu obwawamu, n’ebyafaayo by’embuto okulaba obulungi engeri ekiriisa gye kiyinza okuba nga kyekosa okuzaala omwana atannatuuka.

Baakomekkereza nti obungi bwa seleniyamu n’ekikomo tebyakola kinene mu kuleetera okuzaala omwana atannatuuka, naye nti obungi bwa zinki bweyongera obulabe bw’okuzaala omwana atannatuuka emirundi egisukka mukaaga.
Naye obungi bwa kkopa obunene bwali buzibu eri abanoonyereza, olw’ebyokumanya ebimanyiddwa eby’obutwa.

Okuba n’abakyala 181 bokka abetabye mu kunoonyereza kwaliiko akakwate ku busobozi bw’abanoonyereza okuzuula obulabe obwawamu n’eby’enkula y’amaserengeta agawaggulu, kubanga omuwendo ogusinga obulungi gw’abeetabi gwa 600.
Emmere ya buli lunaku ey’abeetabi teyeekebejjebwa kusobola okuzuula ensibuko z’eby’eddiini bisatu, era Obugabize bw’obuzito n’obuwanvu bw’omubiri (BMI) tebyawandiikibwa.
Kuno kwe kunoonyereza okusooka okw’ekika kyako okukaliriza engeri seleniyamu, ekikomo ne zinki gye bikoze ku bakyala abali lubuto mu Malawi.

Afirika erina omuwendo ogw’okuzaala abaana abatanatuuka oguli waggulu nnyo - ebitundu 18% okusinga amawanga ag’Obugwanjuba agalina ebitundu 5%, era abanoonyereza baagala okumanya oba endya erina ky’ekola.
Embeera y’Okudda Eyo’bwa, Okunywerera ku Kifo n’Okukuuma Ekitundu kya Kifuba ky’Empanga (Malacochersus tornieri) mu Kenya
Ebisolo biraga enneeyisa ey’enjawulo mu bifo n’obudde obw’enjawulo ebiyamba mu kuwonya obulamu bwabyo.
Okutegeera enneeyisa ezo kye kimu ku bikulu mu kutuuka ku kukuma n’okukwata obulungi ebika eby’ensolo eby’ali mu kabi.

Mu kunoonyereza kuno, twagezaako okuzuula oba ekisumuluzo kya Pancake kyandisobodde okudda awaka singa kiggya mu kifo kyakyo era ne tunoonyereza ku kwegatta ku kifo n’obutonde bw’ekika mu bifo byabyo eby’obutonde mu Kitui County, Kenya.

Empisa za kanyama 39 ezibeera mu mpuku za mayinja 12 ezitali wamu zaanoonyerezebwako okuva mu July 2020 okutuuka mu June 2022 nga bakozesa okutunula n’amasimu, okukwata ebifaananyi n’okugatta okukung’aanya ebisanyizo ku mutendera gwa kibiina n’okukungaanya ebisanyizo nga tewali kkomo.
Amagobe kumi na ana gaateekebwako ebyuma ebisindika amawulire era ne gaggya mu bifo byago eby’obujjanjabi ne gatwalibwa mu bifo ebirala ebitali byago era okukwatibwa n’okukola kwago ne kulondoolwa.

Ng’oggyeko enkazi bbiri zokka ezagumira obulungi mu bifo ebiggya eby’okutwalibwa, amasaaka amalala gonna gegegedde okudda awaka, nga 46.15% ku go gaazuula ekkubo eridda mu bifo byago eby’awaka n’obukakafu obw’enjawulo era 15.38% nayo gatuuka mu bifo ebikkirizibwa okuba nga biri mu kitundu kyago eky’awaka.
Okudda awaka okw’omukisa tekusobola kuggwaawo nga tekulaga obukakafu bw’okwesigika kw’ekifo mu kika.

Okusengejja ku kutuula kw’emmamba mu bifo eby’akabinja kwalaga nti tewali njawulo ya maanyi mu bibalo wakati w’emmamba ezaliwo mu bifo ebyo ku ntandikwa n’omuwendo ogwasangibwa mu nnaku 162 ez’okukung’aanya ebiwandiiko (F(1,22) = 0.0699, P >0.05), era kino kyongera okutegeeza obwesigwa obw’amaanyi mu bifo ebyo mu ngeri y’ebika.

Ku ludda olulala, ebintu eby’okukwata ebifaananyi n’okukung’aanya ebintu mu ngeri ya ad libitum byalaga nti amasaawa ga Pancake gaali g’ebyalo nga abasajja b’akakasa nga balwanirira ebyalo byabwe okuva ku basajja abalala abayingira.
Obukalu obwabuze obwa pancake bulina obusobozi obw’ekitalo ‘okuzuula awaka’

Abanoonyereza baakola okuzuula okw’ewuunyisa nga banyikiza empisa z’ebyennyanja eby’omu East Africa ebizibu (Malacochersus tornieri): ensolo zino zisobola okuddamu okuzuula ennyumba yaazo nga zimaze okutwalibwa mu bifo ebiri wala.
Okutegeera engeri n’ensonga lwaki bakikola kiyinza okuba eky’omugaso mu kukuma ebyewalula bino ebitali bingi.
Empisa y’okuzuula amaka gye zino ennyonyi z’enswa ziraga eyitibwa “homing”, era n’ebisolo ebirala bingi biyinza okugikola.
Okusobola okudda mu bifo ebimu kisobozesa ensolo okuddamu okufuna emmere, banne, n’obuddukiro, ekirongoosa emikisa gyazo okugumira n’okuzaala.

Newankubadde empisa y’okudda awaka etegeerezeddwa mu bbiya n’ebyennyanja ebirina amayembe, abanoonyereza mu kunoonyereza kuno bagamba nti tukyamanyi bitono nnyo ku kudda awaka mu bbiya ez’ettaka (ebifaanana n’ebyennyanja ebirina amayembe).
Mu kunoonyereza kuno, abanoonyereza baayagala okutegeera ebisingawo ku mpisa za amasaawa ga pancake mu bifo byabwe eby’obutonde ku mayinja agali mu Kenya.
Baayiga ensolo nga bwe zeyambuka n’okulya, era n’okubategeera bwe zagenda okwebaka mu bifo ebikwekeddwa, oba mu bifo ebirimu amayinja.
Abanoonyereza beetegereza ebibinja by’ennyonyi za pancake okumala emyaka ebiri, era baateekawo kkamera okukwata vidiyo y’ensolo nga tebaziraba.
Era baateekako emitimbagano gya leediyo ku bikwata 14.
Bino bye bintu ebitono ebikkiriza abanoonyereza okulondoola ennyikula y’ensolo, n’okulondoola we ziba zimalira obudde bwazo emisana n’ekiro.
Abanoonyereza oluvannyuma baatwala emyungu egyo egyali gikakasiddwa mu kitundu ekiggya, basobole okubyesomesa mu ngeri eyangu.
Kyokka, mu kwegayirira kw’abanoonyereza, amasaaka abiri gaasooka okudda mu bitundu byago ebyasooka, wakati wa kiromita 1 ne 2.5 okuva we baali baggiddwa.
Kino kye kiseera abanoonyereza lwe baasazeewo okugezaako okusengula ensolo endala okuva mu maka gaazo, okulaba oba zanaalaga empisa ez’ekika kye kimu ez’okudda awaka.

Ekintu ekyewuunyisa, nga kitundu kya bibumbe ekitundu ekimu ku bibumbe byasobola okuddamu okuzuula ekkubo eribaddayo mu bifo byennyini mwe byali bibeera nga tebinnaba kusengulwa, emirundi mingi nga bitambula obuwanvu bwa kiromita 1.5 okusobola okutuuka eyo.
Abalala 15% ku bo baasobola okudda mu kitundu ekinene, naye tebasobola kufuna ekituli mwe baali batwaliddwa okuva ku lubereberye.
Abanoonyereza era baazuula nti ebituli eby’enjawulo bulijjo byalina omuwendo gwe gumu gwa bamalagala abaalimu nga bwebawummulamu, ekiraga nti bamalagala bulijjo bakozesa bifo bimu okwebaka.
Ebyafuna okuva ku kkamera byalaga nti amasaaka ga bba tortoise gaali ga bitundu, nga kitegeeza nti gaalwanagana n’abasajja abalala abagezaako okuyingira mu bitundu byabwe oba mu mpuku.

Abanoonyereza bagamba nti guno gwe mulundi ogwasookera ddala okulaba empisa y’okudda awaka mu bitaano, era nti ebyava mu kunoonyereza kwabwe biraga nti ensolo zino zisinga okwagala okubeera n’okuwummulira mu bifo bimu buli lwe zisobola.
Okunoonyereza kwabwe tekwaalambulula ngeri ennyonyi gye zali zisanga ekkubo ery’okudda awaka, kyokka okunoonyereza okw’omu maaso kulina kussa essira ku kutegeera ekintu kino eky’omugaso.
Kubanga ensolo oluusi zetaaga okusazibwa mu bitundu ebipya olw’okukuuma obutonde, obubaka buno buyinza okuyamba abakuuma obutonde okukuuma amasaawa mu bifo byabwe ebipya.
Okunoonyereza kwakolerwa mu mukago wakati wa bannassaayansi okuva mu Kenya ne China, era kwongereza ku kumanya kwaffe ku mpisa z’okudda awaka mu bikwata n’ensolo endala.
Enkola y’eddagala mu musaayi ey’eddagala lya Rifampicin eriwera ennyo erinywa ku kamwa okusinga eriteekebwa mu muguwa mu balwadde abalina obwongo obuliko akafuba:
Okukeberebwa okw’okusikirizibwa mu ngeri ya Randomized Controlled Trial
Eddagala ery’amaanyi ery’okuyingiza mu muguwa erya rifampicin liyinza okuteeka obulungi ku biva mu kafuba akakosa obwongo naye terisoboka mu bifo ebirina obulwadde obwo obungi.

Twalowooza nti obungi bwa rifampicin mu musaayi bwandibadde bufaanagana wakati w’okukozesa eddagala mu kamwa nga 35 mg/kg w’obuzito bw’omubiri n’okukozesa eddagala mu musaayi nga 20 mg/kg, ekyo ekibadde kisubirwa mu kukebera obusobozi mu kukebera obujjanjabi bw’akafuba akalumba obwongo.

Tukola okunoonyereza okwa byebulijjo okwa kwegatta mu bibiina eby’enjawulo ku ngeri eddagala eritta obuwuka gye likolamu mu mubiri, nga kwegatta mu kukebera okwa by’obujjanjabi okw’okwongera ku ddagala eritta obuwuka ku balwadde b’akafuba akalumba obwongo.
Abetabizi abalina HIV n’obulwadde bwa tuberculous meningitis baakunganyizibwa okuva mu malwaliro g’e South Africa era ne bagabanyizibwa mu bibiina bisatu eby’okufuna eddagala lya rifampicin:
ekiwandiiko (10 mg/kg mu kamwa), ekigera ekisinga obunene (35 mg/kg mu kamwa), n’okuyingiza mu muguwa (20 mg/kg).
Okukungaanya kwa sampolo z’eddagala mu mubiri okw’amaanyi kwakolebwa ku lunaku lwa 3.
Obubaka bwannyonnyolwa nga bakozesa enneekaliriza etali ya bifo, era obubonero bwagerageranyizibwa nga bakozesa omukkati gwa geometric mean ratios (GMRs).
Abetabizi amakumi ana mu mukaaga baayitamu okukung’aanya ebyokulabirako by’eddagala mu mubiri (ekigero ekya bulijjo, n = 17; ekigero ekya waggulu eky’okunywa, n = 15; ekya mu muguwa, n = 14).
Omuwendo gwa CD4 ogwa wakati gwali 130 /mm3 (ekitundu eky’okusatu [IQR], 66 okutuuka ku 253 /mm3).

Omukkati ogw’ebibalo ogw’ekitundu ekya rifampicin wansi w’ekibalo ky’ebbanga okuva ku 0 okutuuka ku 24 ssaawa (AUC0–24) gwali 42.9mg · h/ml (95% ekitundu eky’okwesiga [CI], 24.5 okutuuka ku 75.0mg · h/ml) ku doozi esookerwako, 295.2mg · h/ml (95% CI, 189.9 okutuuka ku 458.8mg · h/ml) ku doozi ey’omu kamwa ey’amaanyi, ne 206.5mg · h/ml (95% CI, 154.6 okutuuka ku 275.8mg · h/ml) ku kugemebwa mu muguwa.

Rifampicin AUC0–24 GMR yali 1.44 (90% CI, 0.84 okutuuka ku 2.21) ate obungi obusinga obw’eddagala mu lusaayisaayi (Cmax) GMR yali 0.89 (90% CI, 0.63 okutuuka ku 1.23) ku bungi obw’eddagala obw’amaanyi obw’okunywa nga bwegeraageranyizibwa ku bungi obw’eddagala obw’okuyingiza mu mubiri.

Plasma rifampicin AUC0–24 yali waggulu oluvannyuma lw’okufuna eddagala mu kamwa ku mutendera gwa 35-mg/kg okusinga bwe kyali ku mutendera gwa 20-mg/kg nga eddagala liweebwa mu muguwa mu nnaku ezisooka ez’okujjanjaba akafuba (TB).
Ebyazuulibwa bino biwagira okuwa eddagala lya rifampicin mu kamwa mu kukebera okuddamu okw’omu maaso ku kafuba akakwata ku bwongo.
Eddagala ery’amaanyi erisinga liyinza okukeberebwa ku balwadde ba HIV abaalina TB meningitis.
Abanoonyereza baakakasizza nti kikulu okutandika okukeberebwa oba obungi obusingako obw’eddagala rifampicin buyinza okuwonya abalwadde ba HIV abaalina akafuba akakosa obwongo.
Okutuuka ku 3 ku buli 5 ku balwadde ba HIV abeerwaza ne tuberculosis meningitis bafa olw’obulwadde buno, obulumba enkola y’obwongo.
Abalamuzi batera okulekerwa obuvune obutaggwa mu nkola y’obusimu obw’ekitundu ekikulu n’obusimu obw’amaanyi obuva mu bwongo.
Kino kisobola okukosa eby’oyiwulira n’okutambula kwabwe.
Abalwadde abamu bafuna okwesika oba obulwadde bw’omutwe, oba ebitundu by’amaaso gaabwe oba omubiri gubalemera.
Rifampicin, eddagala ery’amaanyi eritta obuwuka erikozesebwa okulwanyisa akafuba, lye liweebwa mu bbaati okusobola okutta obuwuka obuleeta akafuba meningitis.
Abalwadde abayi nnyo batera okufuna obuzibu mu kumira amapeera.
Rifampicin kisobola okuweebwa mu muguwa (mu muguwa gw’omusaayi) mu ngeri y’amazzi.
Empiso oluvannyuma esonsekebwa mu musaayi gw’omulwadde okusobola amazzi okutwalibwa mu mubiri.
Tewannaba kukolebwa kukebera kwonna kulaba engeri omubiri gw’omulwadde gy’akkirizamu eddagala nga enkola eno ekolebwa.
Obujjanjabi bw’eccupa bweetaaga ebikozesebwa ebisingawo, okuteekebwa mu ddwaaliro n’omukozi w’ebyobulamu eyayigirizibwa amanyi okutereka akalumira k’eccupa mu ngeri entuufu.
Noolwekyo, tekirina kubeera kyetaago mu bifo ebitalina bulungi bikozesebwa mu nsi.
Abasawo bamanyi dda nti rifampicin teritwalibwa bulungi mu mazzi agali mu bwongo, omugongo n’ekikokko, ebifo awasobola okwekweka obuwuka.
Kyenva lwaki obungi obusingako bwe bwetaagisa okutta obuwuka bwonna mu mubiri gw’omulwadde mu ngeri etuufu.
Naye abanoonyereza baali tebamanyi muwendo gwa ddoosi eyandibadde n’obulungi era nga terina bulabe.

Abanoonyereza okuva mu South Africa n’United Kingdom baayagala okuzuula, nga bakozesa omuwendo muto gw’abalwadde, oba kikyamu okuwa eddagala erya rifampicin mu bungi obusingako oba nga likozesebwa mu bbaati oba nga lifulumizibwa mu muguwa, era n’engeri emibiri gyabwe gye girifuna buli ngeri.

Kikulu okutegeera kino nga abanoonyereza abalala tebannatandika na kugezesebwa okunene, oba okukebera, mwe balina enteekateeka okuwa abalwadde abangi ennyo eddagala lya rifampicin mu bungi obusingako.
Emu ku ngeri ssatu ez’okujjanjaba n’eddagala erya rifampicin yateebwa ku balwadde 46 abali ne HIV mu South Africa abalina akafuba akalumba obwongo.
Eyasooka yali obujjanjabi obwabulijjo obwa kapusulo obuwaibwa abalwadde mu kiseera kino, nga buli kilogulaamu omuntu gy’azitoowera aweebwa 10mg ya rifampicin.
Ekibinja ekirala kyafuna kapusulo ezirimu obungi obusingako obwa 35 milligrams ku kiroogulaamu y’obuzito bw’omulwadde.
Ekibinja ekyokusatu kyafuna obukadde 20 buli kiro ku buzito bw’omuntu mu nsingo.
Sampolo z’omusaayi zaaggibwa ku balwadde oluvannyuma lw’ennaku ssatu.
N’oluvannyuma abanoonyereza baapima obungi bwa rifampicin obwali mu plasma y’omusaayi gwabwe (ekitundu eky’amazzi eky’omusaayi).
Rifampicin ennyingi yasangibwa mu mibiri gy'abalwadde abaafuna obukopo obw'eddagala ery'amaanyi okusinga abo abaafuna eddagala mu musaayi oba eddagala ery'obulijjo.
Obungi bw'eddagala mu pulazima y'omusaayi bwali bumu ku ddozi ey'amaanyi n'obujjanjabi obuyita mu muguwa.
Ebiwendo bino byali waggulu okusinga nga abalwadde bafuna ddoosi esookerwako yokka.

Ng’okusinziira ku banoonyereza, kino kiraga nti obulamu bw’abalwadde abali n’obulwadde bwa tuberculosis meningitis buyinza okuteekebwa ku mutindo singa bafuna eddagala lya rifampicin mu bungi obusingawo.
Tekirina makulu oba nga bakifuna ng’amatabi oba nga kibasindika mu muguwa - ekikulu kiri nti bafuna doozi ezisinga obunene, kubanga emirambo gyabwe kisobola okukuuma ebungi byakyo.
Ebyavaamu bisikiriza ebyazuulibwa mu kukebera okwakolebwa mu Uganda ne Indonesia.

Ebirowoozo bibiri ebitonotono mu Indonesia, nga ekyokulabirako, byalaga nti obulamu bw’abalwadde abangi busobola okutaasibwa singa bawa rifampicin mu bungi obusingawo oba nga bawa ku kamwa oba nga bawa mu muguwa.
Naye kyokka, abanoonyereza balabula nti abeetabi abatonotono be beetaba mu kunoonyereza kuno okusinga bwe baali basuubira, ekintu ekiyinza okukosa ebyavaamu.
Okunoonyereza kwakolerwa mu South Africa.
Kiwagira enteekateeka ey’okukola okukebera okulaba oba kikulu okuwa abalwadde ba HIV abalina akafuba akakwata ku bwongo eddagala erya rifampicin mu bungi.
Kisuubirwa nti enzijanjaba eno ejja kutasa obulamu bw’abantu abangi mu Afirika n’ebitundu ebirala by’ensi gy’ekafuba akalumba obwongo kye kibuzibu ekinene.
Okukozesa wamu komposti n’ebyandayanda kisobola okudduukirira omutindo gw’ettaka ery’omu bukiikakkono obw’omu bukiikakkono obw’oku lubalama olusaanuuse nnyo?
Okuserebwa kw’obugimu bw’ettaka kye kimu ku bizibu ebikulu ebiziyiza okulima ebirime mu Afirika eya wansi w’eddungu Sahara.
Enkola ennungi ey’ebyandayanda n’okukozesa ebigimusa ebikolebwa mu bintu ebibulidde ku ttaka erina obulungi ku ttaka erimanyiddwa n’abawandiisi bangi.

Mu kunoonyereza kuno, okunoonyereza okw’ekiseera kya nnaku 30 mu kifo ky’okukola eby’okunoonyereza kyakolebwa nga bakozesa sampolo za 120 g buli emu ku Haplic acrisol eyayongerwako ebyandayanda by’akawunga (cbio), ebyandayanda by’akawunga ka rice (rbio), ebyandayanda by’akawunga ka coconut (coco300 ne coco700) oba komposti y’obusa bw’enkoko (komposti); era ne co-komposti y’ebyandayanda by’akawunga ka rice (rcocomp) oba co-komposti y’ebyandayanda by’akawunga ka corn (cococomp) ku mutendera gwa 1 % w/w okuteekateeka: ettaka, buli kimu.

Eby’okulongoosa ebirala mu kunoonyereza byali byetooloddwa ku by’okulongoosa eby’ebyennyanja n’ebyandayanda eby’oku kasooli oba ebyandayanda eby’oku bisusunku bya muceere (1% eby’okulongoosa + 1% ebyandayanda: 1% ettaka w/w), okwekebejja engeri gye bikwata ku kufuuyira kw’ettaka, pH y’ettaka; kaboni w’ettaka ogwa mikirooba; obusobozi bw’okukyusa kationi; kaboni w’ettaka omutonde, naitrogeni yonna n’obungi bwa naitrogeni obuliwo.
Ebyandayanda n’ebyokukola komposti nga bikozesebwa bokka oba awamu, n’ebyandayanda ebikompeeteddwa byayongera pH y’ettaka ku mitendera 0.28–2.29 pH nga bigenze okusinga ku byatali byongeddwako.

Okussa omukka okuva mu compost yokka oba ebikuta by’omuceere ebikoleddwa oba ebyandayanda by’akawunga oba ebyandayanda ebigattiddwa ne compost byali waggulu okusinga ku byatali bigattiddwa, ebyali nga eby’okozesebwa ebyandayanda byokka.
TOC mu compost yokka ne ebyandayanda eby’akawunga n’okusindika compost byali waggulu okutuuka ku 37% ne 117% okusinga ku kitongole ekikontuliro.
Okugatta ebyandayanda ebiva mu maganda g’omuceere n’ekomposti kweyongera MBC ku 132% ate nga okukozesa komposti yokka kweyongera MBC ku 247%, nga bwe kugeraageranyizibwa ku kitongole.

Mu nkomerero, okunoonyereza kwalaga nti okukozesa komposti n’ebyandayanda oba ebyandayanda ebikompostiddwa kyokka oba nga byetoolodde byongera ku mutindo gw’ettaka nga pH y’ettaka ne MBC, era ne kyongera ku kuterekebwa kwa C mu ttaka okuyita mu kwongera TOC n’okukendeeza ku kufiirwa kwa C mu ttaka okuyita mu kufuuyira kwa basal.
Ebyandayanda n’ebyokukola komposti bitumbula obulungi bw’ettaka ku birime

Okunoonyereza kuno kwetegereza engeri ebyandayanda, ekintu ekirimu kaboni ennyo era ekirimu obugumu obungi ekikolebwa okuva ku bintu ebisigaddewo, gye kisobola okukozesebwa okwongera ku mutindo gw’ettaka mu Afirika wansi w’eddungu Sahara.
Okunoonyereza kwazuula nti ebyandayanda bitereeza omutindo gw’ettaka mu ngeri y’emu ng’engeri endala ezisaba ssente nnyingi era ezitali zangu kufuna.
Omu ku bizibu ebisinga obunene ebiruma okulima ebirime mu Afirika eya wansi w’eddungu Sahara kwe kuserebwa kw’obugimu bw’ettaka.
Ettaka eddungi lisobola okuzaamu amakungula amalungi, ekisobola okukendeeza obwavu mu byalo n’okuddamu okukyusa okukendeera kw’eby’obugagga eby’ensibo.
Okunoonyereza kulaze nti ebyandayanda, ekintu ekirimu kaboni ennyo era ekirimu obugumu obungi, kisobola okukozesebwa okulongoosa obugimu bw’ettaka.
Ebyandayanda bye biva mu kukyokya ebintu ebirimu obulamu, oba eby’obulamu, nga waliwo empewo entono oba nga tewali mpewo.
Ebyandayanda biraze okulinnyisa obugazi bw’ettaka, okwongera obungi bw’amazzi n’empewo, n’okuzuukusa obuwangwa obutono mu ttaka.

Okunoonyereza kuno kwagezaako okukakasa engeri ebyandayanda n’eby’obufuzi gye bikosa ku mutindo gw’ettaka nga bakozesa ebiraga ng’okussa ettaka omukka, pH y’ettaka, obulamu bw’ebiwuka, obungi bwa kaboni, n’obungi bwa nayitrogeni obuliwo.

Abanoonyereza baakola ebyandayanda okuva mu bisusunku bya kasooli, ebiwooma n’ebyoya bya muceere nga bakozesa pyrolysis, ekigenderera okukozesa ebbugumu ku bintu ebirimu obutonde nga tewali musenyu, ku 450 °C mu kifo ekikolebwa wano.
Abanoonyereza baakola ebyandayanda okuva mu bisusunku bya coconut nga bakozesa pyrolysis ku bbugumu lya 300 °C ne 700 °C.
Abanoonyereza oluvannyuma baateeka sampolo z’ettaka ezimenyeddwa wamu n’ebyandayanda mu kifo ekirimu obugumu okumala ennaku 30.

Buli sampolo yalimu ettaka eritegekeddwa obulungi eriyitibwa Haplic acrisol, eryaweebwa omugatte ogw’enjawulo gw’ebyandayanda ebikolebwa okuva ku kabookisi k’akasooli, obukuta bwa muceere oba obukuta bwa coconut, n’akakungula k’ensolo.
Sampolo endala zaalimu omugatte gw’ettaka n’obusa bw’enkoko obwakozesebwa, n’ebyandayanda eby’akasa ka muceere, n’ebyandayanda eby’akasa ka kasooli, buli kimu.
Buli sampolo yali erimu 1% ya komposti, 1% ku buli ebyandayanda, okusobola abanoonyereza okunoonyereza ku ngeri buli mutabule gy’ekosa ku mutindo gw’ettaka.

Abanoonyereza baazuula nti okwongerako ebyandayanda n’ebyokukola komposti ku ttaka, oba nga byawukanye oba nga byetoolodde, kyayongera omuwendo gwa pH mu ttaka okuva ku 0.28–2.29 pH units, nga gagerageranyiziddwa ku ttaka eritaliiko byonna.
Okuyitamu mu pH kitegeeza nti ettaka lifuuse litali lyonoonefu nnyo.

Okunoonyereza kwazuula nti okussa omukka gwa kaboni ogutono ennyo ogufulumizibwa ettaka kweyongera bwe bagattako compost yokka, oba bwe bagattako compost n’ebisusunku by’omuceere, oba ebyandayanda by’akawunga oba ebyandayanda ebigattiddwa wamu.
Sampolo z’ettaka zaalaga okwongera mu bungi bw’ekirungo kya kaboni omulamu ekya 37% nga bakozesa compost yokka, n’okwongera kwa 117% nga ebyandayanda bya corn cob byagattibwa ne compost.

Obungi bw’emirimu gy’ebiramu ebito bweyongera ku bitundu 132% mu ttaka eryalimu omugatte gwa compost n’ebyandayanda by’akawunga ka rice, nga bw’ogeraageranya n’okweyongera kwa bitundu 247% mu sampolo z’ettaka ezalimu compost yokka.
Ebyava mu kunoonyereza kuno biraga nti kisoboka okukendeeza obukambwe bw’ettaka nga okozesa ebyandayanda, ebisangibwa mu ngeri eyangu era etali ya buseere.
Kino kiva ku nkola endala ey’okuteekamu lime mu ttaka, ekintu ekisaba ssente nnyingi era nga tekifuna mangu eri abalimi abato mu bitundu by’omu sub-Saharan Afirika.
Enkola ya Fayibulini etali ya bulijjo mu Obulwadde bw’Ennyingo n’Enkolagana yaayo n’Obusibage, Okulungula Omubiri n’Okuziba Kw’Omusaayi
Obulabe bw’ebintu ebikwatagana n’omutima mu balwadde ba RA bungi nnyo olw’okulungula omubiri.
Ekkosebwa erikwatagana n’obusibage obulwanyisa obutaffaali obulamu ku ntambuza n’obusobozi obuleeta obulwadde obw’omusaayi obw’akaseera obwa fayibulini(ogen) bikyali tebimanyiddwa.

N’olwekyo twageraageranya ebipimo by’emirimu gy’emyala, okulungula omubiri, okukwatagana kw’omusaayi n’enkyukakyuka z’obutaffaali eziremesa eddagala okukola mu balwadde ba RA n’abantu abalamu era ne tupima enkolagana wakati w’ebipimo eby’enjawulo.
Sampolo z’omusaayi zaggyibwa ku balwadde ba RA 30 n’abazirwanako abalamu obulungi 25 abali mu myaka n’eby’obuntu ebifaanagana.
Obungi bwa SAA, CRP, ICAM-1 ne VCAM-1 bwapimibwa nga bakozesa sandwich immunoassay.
Okukwatagana kw’omusaayi kwonna kwakeberwa nga bakozesa Thromboelastography.
Enkola za fayibulini n’obutonde bw’obuguwa byanoonyerezebwa nga bakozesa ekyuma ekizimbulukusa.

Okukenga n’okubala obungi bwa citrullination mu fayibulini ezikolebwa mu bika byafayibulini byakolebwa nga tukozesa akabonero ka Citrulline monoclonal antibody akaliko ekimuli n’akakodyo ka Confocal Microscopy.
Ebigero bya SAA, CRP ne ICAM-1 byali waggulu nnyo mu balwadde ba RA okusinga ku bantu abatalina bulwadde.

Ebirabirwako bya TEG ebikwata ku kutandika okw’okuziyiza omusaayi (R ne K), omuwendo gw’okwegatta kwa fayibulini (α-Angle), n’ebbanga erikwata ku kutuuka ku kutondeka obutaffaali obusinga obungi (TMRTG) byali bitonotono mu balwadde ba RA.
Ebiramulirwako ebikwata ku maanyi g’akabumbe (MA, MRTG, TGG) tebyali na njawulo ya maanyi mu by’enkyukakyuka z’obutaffaali eziremesa eddagala okukola ne mu bikwata ku by’okulabirako.

Okusingira ddala, abanoonyereza baakebera engeri okulungula omubiri n’enkyukakyuka mu ntobo gye bikosa puloteyini ez’enjawulo ezikwatagana n’okukwatagana kw’omusaayi, eziyitibwa fayibulini.

Puloteyini zino ziba nga mikutu emiramba egikola “mesh-work” esinga obukulu ku bika bya musaayi, era enkyukakyuka zonna ku fayibulini zennyini zisobola okuba n’eby’enkya ku ngeri y’okukwatagana kw’omusaayi mu ngeri yonna.
Abanoonyereza baageraageranya sampolo z’omusaayi z’abalwadde ba RA ku sampolo eziva ku bantu abalamu.

Mu buli nsonga, abanoonyereza baali banoonya “obubonero” mu musaayi obulaga okulungula omubiri, wamu n’enjawukana ezitali za bulijjo mu ngeri y’okukwatagana kw’omusaayi esobola okwongera obulabe bwa CVD.
Ebiwundu byennyini byakeberwa era ne mu mikrosikopu, okusobola okuzuula enkyukakyuka zonna mu ngeri fayibulini puloteyini zaabyo gye zitegekeddwaamu.
Abanoonyereza baalaba nti ebikuta okuva mu balwadde ba RA byakola amangu okusinga eby’abantu abalamu, era nti emiguwa gya puloteyini gye byakolebwamu gyali minene nnyo okusinga fayibulini ezabulijjo.
Waaliwo n’enkyukakyuka ku asidi akola puloteyini ezikwata omusaayi, ezaviirako okuleeta obusobozi bw’omubiri okulwanyisa endwadde, ne kiviirako okulungula omubiri okwongera.
Abanoonyereza abalala baalabye enkyukakyuka mu kikula kya amino acid kya fayibulini mu ngalo z’abalwadde ba RA edda, naye kino kye kiseera ekisooka abanoonyereza okulaba engeri y’emu mu musaayi.

Nga gattiddwa ku nkyukakyuka endala ezirabiddwa mu musaayi ogwekwata, bye baazuula biyinza okuyamba bannassaayansi okutegeera ennyo enkolagana wakati wa RA ne CVD, n’engeri y’okuzuula obubonero obusooka obw’endwadde zino.
Newankubadde ng’ebyazuulibwa ebyasooka bino biraga essuubi, kyetaagisa okukimanya nti sampolo eyakozesebwa mu kunoonyereza kwali kutono mu ngero.

Abanoonyereza era baayogera nti engeri gye bakozesa okuzuula enkyukakyuka mu amino acid mu puloteyini nayo yandiba nga yafuna ebyava mu bintu ebitali bimu, omukkati nga okukebera okw’enjawulo okuruubirira fayibulini kwetaagibwa okusigamizibwa ku ebyavaamu mu biseera eby’omu maaso.

Ekiseera nga kiyiseewo, okutegeera enkolagana ezitali zangu wakati wa RA n’akatyabaga akawaggulu k’obulwadde bw’omutima kiyinza okutumbula embeera y’abalwadde ba RA nga tuyiga okuzuula n’okujjanjaba endwadde zino mu ngeri etuufu.
Abanoonyereza okuva mu South Africa, Denmark ne Bungereza baali mu kifo ky’okunoonyereza kuno, ekyaweereddwa ssente ekitongole ky’ebyobulamu ekya South Africa.
Enteebereza y’embeera y’obudde ku nnyanja eri abakozesa abali ku lubalama lw’ennyanja – endowooza, okukozeseka n’okukwatibwako

Okunoonyereza kuno kuluubirira okukyusa enjawukana wakati wa ssaayansi n’abantu ba bulijjo mu ngeri y’okubaawo obutakwatagana mu kutambuza n’okwetaaga kw’obubaka obumanyiddwa nga ebbanga lya okukozesebwa.
Mu mbeera eno, tukyaza obukulu bw’obubaka obukwata ku mbeera y’obudde ey’omu nnyanja (metocean) nga bwe bulabibwa abakozesa mu mawanga abiri agali mu Bukiikaddyo bwa Nsi:
South Afirika ne New Zealand.

Wano, obudde tebuli ku kutunuulira byokka engeri abantu gye balowoozaamu, okukozesebwa n’okukwatibwa kw’enteebereza y’eby’okulabula eby’amaanyi naye wabula ku kutunuulira engeri y’okukwatagana n’enteebereza ezisookerwako n’eziramba.
Okunoonyereza kwakolebwa nga kuyita mu kunoonyereza, okwateekebwateekebwa ku bibuuzo bisatu eby’okunoonyereza.

Ebibuuzo eby’okunoonyereza byali bikwata ku nsonga ezitali zimu okuva ku byuma ebikozesebwa okuteebereza embeera y’obudde, obutuufu n’obwenkanya, okukozeseka, erinnya ly’ebitongole, n’obutakakafu obukwata ku nkyukakyuka y’embeera y’obudde (okumala okwogera ku ntono).
Ebibuuzo by’oku mutimbagano byagabanyizibwa nnyo okuli abakozesa ab’okusanyusa n’ab’ebyobusuubuzi.
Okunoonyereza kuno kwekaliriza okuzuula obuwangwa obw’enjawulo obw’okusalawo obuliko engeri ey’enjawulo gye bukoze ku byetaago by’abakozesa b’ennyanja eziri ku lubalama.

Okwekaliriza okw’okukkiriziganya ku by’ennono (CCA) kwakozesebwa okunoonya okutegeeragana okw’awamu n’obwawuko mu ngeri abantu gye balowoozaamu mu kibiina kyonna eky’abayanukula awamu n’ebibinja ebya mu bitundu n’ebya mu mawanga.
Twasanga enjawukana mu kutegeeragana mu kibiina kyonna (abantu abetaba okuva mu mawanga gombi n’ebitongole byonna nga bigattiddwa) okusinga ebibinja ebitali bimu by’abakozesa.

Abeetabi bonna bwe baagattibwa wamu baalaga okukkiriziganya okw’ekitundu ku buwangwa ku nsonga ezaayolesebwa naye nga waliwo enjawukana mu ndowooza ku mutendera gwa ggwanga, nga kino kiraga obuwangwa obutono obusoboka.

Okwekenneenya ebibinja ebya ggwanga n’eby’ebyensimbi mu ngeri ey’enjawulo, twazuula okukkiriziganya okw’amaanyi mu ndowooza y’ebyobuwangwa mu kibinja ky’abakozesa b’omu South Africa, nga waliwo okukkiriziganya okw’amaanyi newankubadde nga tewali kwegatta ku by’ebyensimbi.
Ekibinja ky’abakugu b’ebyobusuubuzi mu New Zealand kyali n’okukkiriziganya okutono ennyo n’ebibinja ebirala byonna.
Tukubaganya ebirowoozo ku ngeri ebyazuuliddwa byaffe gye birina ku bintu eby’omugaso mu kukwatibwa kwa buweereza era n’okukola enteebereza ez’omugaso.
Ebintu bingi ebikulu ebikwata ku nteebereza ezisinziira ku ssaayansi mu biseera eby’omu maaso nabyo byetegerekeka, nga beetegereza enkyukakyuka y’embeera y’obudde ezisuubirwa.
Tukubira nga tusaba ekifaananyi ky’enteekateeka okulaga enkolagana ey’amaanyi wakati w’okukulaakulanya awamu ebikolebwa eby’obunnabbi n’obutuufu/okugoberera eby’obusobozi bw’eby’obusobozi.
Abantu ba South Afirika, n’abantu ba New Zealand bakkiriza enteebereza ku mbeera y’obudde ku nnyanja

Abantu ba South Afirika n’aba New Zealand abakolera n’ababeera ku bizinga eby’oku lubalama beesigama ku buweereza obw’okuteebereza ku mbeera y’obudde obwangu okukozesa, era obutera okuwa ebiteeberezo ebituufu.
Ebitongole ebikola ku nteebereza y’obudde eby’eggwanga n’ebitundu eby’enjawulo ebya kompyuta bitangaaza ku bintu ebinaabaawo ku mbeera y’obudde.
Bagezaako okuba abatuufu era abamugaso nga bwe kisoboka.
Eby’obusobozi bungi eby’obusomesa n’eby’okulowooza eby’obusomesa bikwatagana n’okuteebereza okwo.

Mu kunoonyereza kuno abanoonyereza baasalawo okutunuulira engeri abantu mu South Afirika ne New Zealand gye bakozesa eby’okulabula eby’obudde - amawanga gombi galina ennyanja empanvu, naye galina abantu ab’enjawulo nnyo n’eby’obudde eby’oku nnyanja ebitali bimu.

Baayagala okuzuula emirundi abantu ababeera ku lubalama lw’ennyanja gye bakozesa eby’okulabula eby’eggwanga oba eby’obusuubuzi, ku nsonga ki era oba nga baalaba nga bino byali bya mugaso era ebyesigika.
Bino bye bintu eby’omugaso nga twetegereza engeri enkyukakyuka y’embeera y’obudde mu biseera ebijja gye zayinza okukosa okuteebereza embeera y’obudde.
Ebibuuzo by’oku mutimbagano byayanukulibwa Abasouth Africa 31 n’Abanew Zealand 126.

Bano baalimu abantu abakozesa enteebereza y’obudde ku lw’emirimu (nga abavubi n’ebitongole ebinoonya n’okutaasa), n’abalala abetaba mu mizannyo egyekuusa ku nnyanja n’emirimu egy’okwewummuza nga okusamba amayengo, okuseeyeeya, oba okunaaba.
Abanoonyereza baabuuza ku bwangu obuli mu kukozesa empeereza y’okubikkula eby’obudde gye baagala, n’engeri gye zikwatagana n’obutuufu n’obwenkanya bw’ebyo ebibikkuliddwa.
Abetabizi baalondawo ebintu ebyabafuula eby’omugaso era eby’omugaso gye bali era ne bagamba oba bino bisobola okukyuka olw’enkyukakyuka y’embeera y’obudde.
Era baalina okwogera oba nga beesiga amakulu agawaweebwa eby’obudde eby’eggwanga lyabwe, n’engeri gye baali bawuliramu ku makulu ago.
Abantu abasinga okuva mu South Africa abaatwala obutundu mu kunoonyereza kuno baali baserufa, oba abantu abaayambanga mu kunoonyereza n’okunoonya n’okutaasa oba emirimu gy’okunoonyereza.
Abantu abasinga obungi mu New Zealand abaddamu ebibuuzo baatunuulira enteebereza y’obudde kubanga baayagalanga okugenda kuvuba, okusiba eryato oba okusitula okugenda mu nnyanja.
Abeetabye okuva mu mawanga gombi baali beesiga obubaka obubawereddwa eby’obudde okuva mu buweereza bwabwe obw’eggwanga.
Baayagala eby’okulabula ebikwata ku bintu eby’obudde ebirina obutuukirivu, obw’enkola emu, ebyangu okukozesa era ebirina ebintu ebisobola okukyusibwa okusobola okutuukana n’ebyo bye beetaaga.
Abantu abakozesa obuweereza buno ku lw’ensonga z’eby’emirimu mu ngeri yonna baazuula nti enteebereza y’eby’obudde eby’oku nnyanja okumpi n’obutaka tekyali kituufu kimala.
Obubaka obuva mu bitundu ebimu bwali bwesigika okusinga obuva mu bitundu ebirala.
Abantu ba South Africa baalina empisa y’okukozesa eby’obudde emirundi mingi okusinga abantu ba New Zealand, era nga babiraba waggulu emirundi emu olunaku.
Ku beetabi 9 ku buli 10, enkola ennungi ennyo ey’okuteebereza yali ya mugaso nnyo.
Abasinga baayagala obuweereza obwawa omusono gwa nnaku ssatu okutuuka ku musanvu mu maaso.
Abantu abaakolanga mu kulima ebyennyanja oba abaali bateekwa okuteekateeka ku nsonga z’eby’okwerinda ezisobola okubaawo baali baagala enteebereza ez’ebbanga eddene n’ez’ennaku z’omwaka.

Abakozesa abasinga baali bakkiriza nti olw’okwongera kw’enkyukakyuka y’embeera y’obudde, eby’okuteebereza bijja kuba birina okukozesa obubaka obusinga obw’ensonga mu by’ensi mu maaso okusobola okuteekateeka ebiteeberezo ebituufu.
Waliwo kunoonyereza kutono nnyo okwakoleddwa mu mawanga agasangibwa mu kitundu ekya Southern Hemisphere.
Abanoonyereza basuubira nti baasobodde okuyiga ebimala okuva mu beetabi nga basinziira ku bibuuzo bye baababuuzizza.
Obunafu obuyinza okubaawo era bwe buno nti abantu abasinga obungi ababeera mu New Zealand okusinga abali mu South Africa be beetaba mu kunoonyereza kuno.
Omulimu gwabwe gujja kuyamba abantu abakolera ku buweereza bw’okuteebereza embeera y’obudde okutondawo ebintu ebisinga obulungi ebikwata ku byetaago by’abakuguzi baabwe.
Bajja kusobola okukola enkyukakyuka n’okulongoosa nga basinziira ku ngeri abakozi baabwe gye basanyukira n’ensonga lwaki bakikozesa.
Enkola ey’Okwetabamu mu Kwekenenya Obukuuma Obutonde bw’Enkola z’Obulimi:
Ekyokulabirako kya Lushoto
Ekiruubirirwa ky’obulimi n’obulunzi obukuuma obutonde (CSA) kirina amaanyi agakyeyongera mu nsi yonna.
Naye kyokka, tekiraga bulungi ku bintu ebirina okuba mu mpagi zaabyo ssatu—okukulaakulana, okuvvuunuka n’okukendeeza obulabe.
N’olwekyo, CSA ekwata ku nkola nnyingi ez’enjawulo mu by’obulimi/tekinologiya, ekikifuula kizibu okussa CSA ku mwanjo.
Mu kusooka, waliwo obutabaawo kwa mitendera egya lwatu era egikola obulungi wamu n’enkola ez’okwekebejja obukuuma obutonde bw’ebikolebwa.
Kisembayo, waliwo obubaka butono obuliwo ku ngeri engeri ez’enjawulo ez’okuyingira mu by’okulima ezimaze okuteekebwawo nga CSA bwe zikosa, naddala mu nsi ezikyakula.
Okusembayo, okussa CSA ku mwanjo tekufa ku ndowooza z’abaganyulwa okukakasa nti enteekateeka zino zisoboka, zikwatagana era zirina omukisa omunene ogw’okukkirizibwa.
Wano, twannyonnyola enkola empya ey’okwetabamu mu kukebera obukuuma obutonde bw’ebikolebwa mu bulimi obutono.
Kino kiraga obubonero ku mutendera gw’ebyalo (n’ebitundu) eby’emmere ey’okwerindisa n’ensonga z’okwegendereza mu CSA.

Kino kisinziira ku kuteekateeka okw’okwetabamu okw’okupima ebikolebwa, nga kiyamba mu kuteekawo embeera ey’okukola okunoonyereza okw’ensibuko n’okw’omu maaso ku bikwata ku nkolagana n’embuzi y’obudde.
Enkola eno yagezesebwa ku balimi 72 abakola ku ngeri ez’enjawulo ez’okusomesa CSA mu kyalo ekikuuma obutonde ekya Lushoto, Tanzania.

Abalimi baasiima nnyo enteekateeka ezongera ku bulungi bw’ettaka n’enkola yaalyo, ezikendeeza ku kutoloka kw’amazzi ku ttaka, era ne ziddiza ettaka eryonoonese olw’eby’okukosa ebirungi ku amakungula n’obulimi bw’ebirime mu biseera eby’akaseera.
Mu bungi, enteekateeka za CSA zaayongera ku buziina bw’ebyokulya, okukulaakulanya ebyokulya, okuliisa n’enfuna.
Enkola eno kyangu okugikyuusa okusinziira ku bitundu eby’enjawulo n’enkola z’ebyobulimi era esobozesa okussa ekitiibwa mu bikolebwa ebikulu.
Naye tuteesa nti CSA etwalibwe ng’ekitundu ky’okulondoola, okwekeneenya n’enkola ey’okuyiga.
Enkola empya ez’okulondoola ziyamba bannassaayansi n’abalimi okuteekateeka enkyukakyuka y’embeera y’obudde.
Bannassaayansi abakolera wamu n’abalimi mu Tanzania kati basobola okukebera engeri enkola empya ez’ebyobulimi gye zikola okusobola okukendeeza ku kukosebwa kw’enkyukakyuka y’embeera y’obudde.
Basuubira nti enkola yaabwe ejja kwongera ku mmere ey’okwerindisa n’amakungula g’abalimi mu bitundu ebirala by’ensi era.
“Obulimi n’obulunzi obukuuma obutonde” kye kimu ku bintu Ensi Yonna ezzaamu amaanyi okuyamba abalimi abato abali ku lutiba okweetegekera enkyukakyuka y’embeera y’obudde.
Omulimi akuuma obutonde agendera ku nkyukakyuka mu mbeera y’obudde era asobola okwongera ku mmere ey’okwerindisa nga ayongera ku bungi bw’ebimera bye.
Kino kye kimu ku nsonga ezikosa abalimi b’omu Tanzania, kubanga eggwanga liri mu mbeera y’okufuna amakungula amatono g’ebirime by’emmere ebikulu olw’enkyukakyuka y’embeera y’obudde.

Naye, abanoonyereza bagamba nti kizibu okukebera obuwanguzi bw’enkola ezikuuma obutonde, nga okukozesa obusa, era abalimi bennyini tebabeerangako beebuuzibwa oba enkola zino zikola nga bwe zaali zitegekeddwa.

Mu kunoonyereza kuno, abanoonyereza baayagala okukola engeri ey’okupima obuwanguzi bw’enkola ezikuuma obutonde, nga basinziira ku kwongera ku mmere ey’okwerindisa n’okugenda mu maaso n’eby’enkyukakyuka.
Okutandika, baasoma mu kunoonuereza kw’ebyobulimi endala ne bakola ebiwandiiko 2 ebyalimu ensonga 14, oba “ebikwekebwako”, ebikulu mu kukebera emmere ey’okwerindisa n’okwefaananyiriza.

Awo, nga bakolera mu Disitulikiti ya Lushoto mu Tanzania, abanoonyereza baakolagana n’abalimi ab’omu kitundu n’abakugu mu by’obulimi ab’enjawulo okuzuula ebintu ebisinga obukulu okuva mu lukalala oluli.
Abalimi baalonda okukola emmere ng’ekyokulabirako ekikulu nnyo okulaba nga wabaawo emmere ey’okwerindisa.
Mu ngeri endala, enteekateeka yonna eyongera ku makungula okuva mu birime byabwe yali ewagiddwa nnyo.

Mu kiseera kino, ku nsonga y’okugenda mu maaso n’enkyukakyuka, abalimi baali n’okwegomba okw’enjawulo mu nkola ezibayamba okuuma ettaka ly’ennimiro zaabwe, n’ezikwata ku kwongera ku kutegeera kwabwe, obukugu, n’ensimbi ze bafuna.
Nga abanoonyereza bamaze okumanya obukulu bwa buli kyoleko, baasobola okubikozesa okukebera oba engeri mukaaga ez’okwenyigira mu Lushoto zaali n’obuwanguzi.
Mu buli nsonga, baabuuza abalimi b’omu kitundu, ku lutiba lwa 1-5, oba nga waliwo okwongera mu buli kibonerezo okuva lwe okutandika okw’emirimu.
Kino kyabakkiriza okulaba engeri enkola ez’enjawulo gye zaalina engeri ey’amaanyi ku mmere ey’okwerindisa n’okugendereza.
Baazuula nti ebyakolebwa 3 ku 6 byokka bye byali n’akakwate akatuufu.
Ebyo byali okufuuyira ebikoola, ebika by’ebimera ebigumira ekyeya, n’okutwala ebyokulya ebirungi eri ensolo ezirundibwa.
Abanoonyereza bagamba nti enkola yaabwe esobozesa okwekiriza nti enteekateeka ezijja zituukiriza ebyetaago by’abalimi b’e Lushoto wamu n’ebyokulabirako by’ebyobulimi ebikuuma obutonde.
Bategeeza nti okulonda enkola entuufu nakyo kyongera ku mukisa gw’abalimi okuteesa ku nkola ennungi eri baliraanwa baabwe, bwegutyo nga basasaanya ebirowoozo ebikuuma obutonde.

Mu ngeri ennene, enkola eno esobola okukozesebwa mu bitundu ebirala, era esobola okuyamba okukakasa nti enkola ezikuuma obutonde zikwata ku mbeera z’ewaffe n’obumanyirivu bw’abalimi nga bayita mu kulondoola n’okwekenneenya okw’ensonga.
Mu kukola bwe kityo, enteekateeka z’obulimi n’obulunzi obukuuma obutonde ziba n’amaanyi ag’okuyitamu era ne zifuna okutegeerekeka, mu Tanzania n’awalala mu Africa.
Okunoonyereza kwakolebwa omukago gwa bannassaayansi okuva mu Kenya ne Budaaki.
Obuwuka Obuleeta Endwadde mu Bisolo Ebirina Amagumba: Okutegeera okuva mu South Africa
Okunoonyereza ku bitonde ebireetawo endwadde ng’endyo engwira tekufuna kwegattako kungi mu kitundu ky’eby’obulumbaganyi bw’ebitonde.
Obuwuka obuleeta endwadde obutwaliddwa mu bitundu ebirala busobola okuba n’eby’enkizo ku bitonde ebiramu, obutonde bw’ensi mwe bibeera, n’eby’enfuna obutonde buno bwe butambulira.

Mu ssuula eno, tukozesa okwekaliriza kw’endwadde ezayingizibwa mu nsolo z’ewaka n’ez’omu nsiko (obulwadde bwa rabies mu mbwa, obulwadde bwa bovine tuberculosis, n’obulwadde bwa rinderpest) n’abantu (obulwadde bwa smallpox, measles n’akawuka akaleeta obutaffaali bw’omubiri, HIV) okusobola okulaga engeri obuwuka obuleeta endwadde buno gye buyinza okukosaamu.
Ekikosa ennyo okutuusa leero kyali ekya rinderpest, ekyaleetera okufa kw’ente obukadde, era ne kimalawo ddala ebika ebimu by’ensolo z’omu nsiko okuva mu bitundu binene eby’obukiikaddyo bwa Afrika.
Kino nakyo kyakosa nnyo ebyenfuna by’omu kitundu, era ne kivamu enkyukakyuka ennene ku ntambuza n’enkola y’obutonde bw’ensi.

Endwadde ya Rinderpest yaggyibwawo mu nsi yonna, naye endwadde eva ku kulumwa embwa n’akawuka ka bovine tuberculosis bikyaliwo, era obwegendereza obutaleka na n’okugikugira bijja kwetaagibwa okusobola okubirwanyisa.
Ku ndwadde z’abantu, omusujja gw’ensiri guzaaliddwaawo mu nsi yonna, naye engeri obulwadde buno gye bwaleetebwa abawangaalira b’Abazungu yali ya kitalo nnyo.

Mu ntandikwa y’emyaka gy’ekikumi eky’ekkumi n’omusanvu (1700s), ekitundu kinene (okutuuka ku 90% mu bamu ku bitundu) ky’abantu bannansangwa ab’e Khoekhoe kyafa, ne kisanyawo omuwendo gwabwe n’enkola y’obulamu bwabwe, era ne basigaza abawonyewo batono okufuuka abakozi ku ffaamu.
HIV, eyasooka okukwatibwa mu South Afirika mu 1982 nayo erina enkyukakyuka ennene era eddagala erikkakkanya lyokka kati lisasula gavumenti ZAR 66.4 billion buli mwaka.
Tuteekamu n’akawuka ka West Nile n’omusujja gwa African Swine Fever nga ebyokulabirako by’endwadde ezava mu Afirika, era nga ziyinza okufuuka ekizibu eky’amaanyi mu nsi yonna.
Tusuubira nti endwadde empya zijja kweyoleka nga abantu bwe bakyeyongera okusaasaanya obutale bwabwe mu bifo eby’omu nsiko, era nga n’obungi bw’ebyobusuubuzi bwe bweyongera.
Bannassaayansi kye bamanyi ku bintu ebitonotono eby’enoonyi ebireeta endwadde mu South Africa

Essuula y'ekitabo kino esumulula amakulu agaggya ku ndwadde nga rinderpest, rabies, measles ne HIV, zonna ezireetebwa obulwadde obwonoonyi (akawuka, bakutiriya n'ebitonde ebilala ebitono ebikolebwa ng'olulyo olwonoonyi, nga kitegeeza nti tebisangibwa mu butonde mu kitundu ekimu).
Endwadde zino zonna zikosa ebisolo n’abantu mu South Africa, era obulwadde bwe bubalukawo bulyoka bukosa ebyenfuna by’eggwanga.
Mu kitundu ky’okunoonyereza ekiyitibwa ‘sayansi y’ebirumbaganyi’, basayansi bayiga ku bitonde ebikula bulungi era ne bikola obulabe nga bimaze okuleetebwa mu bitundu ebipya mwe bitasangibwa bulijjo.
Okunoonyereza okusinga kwetegerezza ebitonde “ebirumbaganyi” ebinene nga bimera n’ensolo, naye ebitonde ebirumbaganyi ebirabika obutono ebireeta endwadde nabyo by’akulu nnyo.
Mu ssuula eno, abawandiisi baayogera ku ndwadde ezimu ez’ensolo n’abantu mu South Africa eziva ku bintu ebiramu ebitonotono ebyayingizibwa.
Baagamba nti obulwadde obw’amaanyi ennyo bwali ‘rinderpest’, obwakizuulibwa mu South Africa mu 1896.
Rinderpest kyaleetebwawo akawuka era kaali kakosa ente n’embogo.
Akawuka ke kennyini ke kaaleeta omusujja gw’ensiri mu bantu.
Abantu bangi abali mu byalo baalumbibwa enjala oluvannyuma lw’okubalukawo kw’obulwadde mu 1896, naye kati obulwadde buno bwazikirizibwa okuyita mu kugemesa.
Abawandiisi bagamba nti wakati wa 1772 ne 1861, embwa nnyingi mu South Africa zaalina endwadde eva ku kulumwa ensolo, newankubadde abantu tebaamanya ndwadde ki eno.
Mu 1893, kyali kimanyiddwa nti endwadde eva ku kulumwa ensolo eva ku akawuka, n’olwekyo gavumenti yasalawo okutta embwa ezirina obulwadde n’okugema ezo ezitalina.
Naye kino tekyaasaanyaawo ndwadde era kyakosa n’ensolo nnyingi ez’omu nsiko nga embizzi, empologoma, embwa z’omu nsiko, amagunju n’ebibe.
Abawandiisi baagamba nti mu 1928, abaana 2 baalumwa Kakolwa era ne bafa olw’endwadde eva ku kulumwa ensolo.
Okuva olwo, endwadde eva ku kulumwa ensolo yafuuka eyawulirwa mu ggwanga lya South Africa.
Bagamba nti mu 1954, abantu bangi mu South Afirika baakosebwa era ne balwala omusujja gw’ensiri.
Mu kiseera ekitabo kino bwe kyali kiwandiikibwa, omusujja gw’ensiri gwali gutta abaana nga 400 buli lunaku.
Baagamba nti omusujja gw’ensiri gwali gusangibwa nnyo mu bifo awali abantu n’ente nga batabagana nnyo.
Abawandiisi era baayogedde ku bulwadde obuyitibwa bovine tuberculosis (BTB), obuleetebwa akawuka ka bakitiriya.
BTB yatta ente, embogo, ensolo ez’omu nsiko ezirina amayembe, empologoma, empologoma ento, enkudu, enkima n’ensolo.
Baagamba nti obulwadde bwa BTB bwategeezebwa okusooka mu kisaawe kya South Africa mu 1996.
Gavumenti yaziiyiza obulwadde nga etta embogo ezaali zirwadde.
Abanoonyereza baagamba nti akawuka akalala, akaayingizibwa mu South Africa abatambuze okuva mu Bulaaya, kaaleeta endwadde eyitibwa ‘smallpox’ mu bantu.
Obulwadde bwatta abantu ba Khoekhoe abasoba mu 90% ab’omu kitundu.
Ku nkomerero y’okwasaasaana kw’endwadde, obuwangwa bwa Khoekhoe bwali bugguddwa ddala.
Abawandiisi era baategeeza ku kawuka akaleeta obulwadde bwa AIDS.
Abasayansi bakyateebereza nti akawuka kaatwalibwa mu bantu okuva ku nsolo, mu ngeri eyitibwa zoonosis.
Akawuka kaasooka okukwatibwa mu South Afirika mu 1982.
Baagamba nti, okuva mu 2019, HIV teyalina ddagala erigema oba okuwonya.
Baamaliriza essuula nga boogera ku Kawuka ka West Nile n’Omusujja gwa Swine ogwa Afrika, bye baagamba nti byasibuka mu Afrika ne bisaasaana okutuuka mu Yuropi ne Amerika.
Akawuka ka West Nile kaali kasaasaanyizibwa ensiri era ne kitta ennyonyi ennyingi, naye era ne kakosa embalaasi n’abantu.
Baagamba nti ensolo ng’ensiri n’embizzi z’omu nsiko zisaasaanya obulwadde bwa swine fever obw’omu Africa.
Obulwadde bwakosa ngulu, era bwakosa nnyo ebyobusuubuzi by’engulu.
Abawandiisi baagamba nti baayogera ku ndwadde ezireetebwa obuwuka bwa bakitiiriya n’akawuka, kyekiva kibeera nti essuula eno teyeetooloola bulungi obuwuka obutinniinya bwonna.
Abaakola okunoonyereza kuno baava mu South Africa.
Enkola ey’okusala eyawandiikibwa ku bujulizi ey’okujjanjaba Odontogenic keratocyst
Okutereeza okw’omugaso okw’ekirwadde kya odontogenic keratocyst (OKC) kyeyongera okuba ekintu eky’omugaso era ekitawaanya mu byawandiikibwa eby’okusosola mu kamwa n’okuva ku matu.
Kati, tewali kutegeeragana ku bujjanjabi obusinga obulungi obw

Ku ngeri ez’enjawulo ez’okujjanjaba eziriwo, tewali ngeri n’emu okutuusa leero eyalaze obubonero bw’okuddamu n’akomawo obutaliimu oba obuli kumpi n’obutaliimu okuggyako okusalako ekitundu ekinene n’ensalo ezirabika bulungi.

Olw’obutabaawo bukakafu obw’ebyokujjanjaba obukozesebwa mu kujjanjaba abalwadde abali n’obulwadde bwa odontogenic keratocyst mu bitabo, kunoonyereza kuno kulina ekigendererwa eky’okulaga engeri y’okujjanjaba, nga kisinziira ku byava mu okunoonyereza kw’ebibalo, ekisubirwa okuba eky’omugaso mu kutumbula enzijanjaba y’abalwadde abali n’obulwadde buno.

Okukozesa ebipimo nga; obunene, ekika ky’ekiwundu (ekikulu oba ekiddirira), obulwadde obw’ekika oba obw’ekimu, obulamu bw’ebituli, n’obutonde obw’ekiwundu; twetegese omuti ogw’okusalawo, okusobola okukola enteekateeka y’obujjanjabi n’okuyamba okufuna omukisa omutono ogw’okuddamu okufuna obulwadde mu kujjanjaba odontogenic keratocyst.
Abanoonyereza bateesa engeri ezisingako mu kujjanjaba obulwadde bw’akamwa.

Nga bakuŋŋaanya ebiva mu kunoonyereza okwaliwo, abanoonyereza baateekateeka entambula entuufu abasawo gye bayinza okugoberera okuzuula n’okujjanjaba abalwadde abalina obulwadde bw’akamwa obuyitibwa ‘odontogenic karatocyst’ (OKC).
OKC kizigiro, oba okumerera okutali kwa bulijjo, ku matama g’omuntu.
Abasawo basanga obuzibu okujjanjaba embeera eno, era abalwadde batera okufuna endwadde endala ya OKC wadde nga baafuna okuwona obulungi.
Abasawo kati banoonya engeri ezisobola okuwonya obulabe buno obuli ku matama mu ngeri etuufu era ey’olubeerera.
Mu kunoonyereza kuno, abanoonyereza baanoonya amangu g’eby’okukola abasawo bye basaanye okukwata okuzuula n’okujjanjaba obulwadde.
Baakikola nga banoonyereza mu biwandiiko ebiriwo, oba ebiwandiiko by’obusobozi, ebikwata ku OKC.
Baali banoonya bunnambiro amakulu ku ngeri abasawo gye baakolamu ku OKC mu bbanga lya mwaka gumu, nga bwe kyabuulirwa mu mpapula 46 ze baazuula.

Abanoonyereza baazuula nti OKC yali y’emu ku bulwadde obwasinga okuba mu basajja okusinga mu bakyala, era nga eyinza okukosa abantu okutuuka ku myaka 90, newankubadde nga yali y’emu ku bulwadde obwasinga okuba wakati w’emyaka 20 ne 30.
Obulwadde bwakosa nnyo ku nsingo esinga wansi.
OKC etandika munda mu ggumba, nga okuzimba kw’eddwaaliro kulabika nga wayise akaseera.
Abalwadde bulijjo baawulira obulumi era baalina ekintu ekivaamu (omutwe, nga ng’omusaayi, oguva mu kiwundu oba ekibulabula), era n’emizi gy’amenyo gaabwe gisobola okuva mu kifo.
Baateesa nti abasawo basaanidde okuggyawo ekituli kyonna n’amenyo agali okumpi.

Nga bimaze okuggyibwamu, balina okukozesa eddagala eriyitibwa Carnoy’s solution, wamu n’omukka ogw’amaanyi ogw’akabugumu (omukka ogw’amaanyi ogukozesebwa okuggyawo amangu olususu olwononekedde) ne fluorouracil (era amanyiddwa nga 5FU, eddagala erikozesebwa mu kujjanjaba kookolo).
Oluvannyuma lw’obujjanjabi buno, abanoonyereza baateesa nti omuntu alina okubeerawo n’okukebera eby’obulamu okumala emyaka 25.
Baagamba nti obujjanjabi buno bwali businga obulungi ku bizigiro ebito okusinga ekibala kya sitiroberi (3 cm).
Ku bizinga ebisinga obunene obwa 3 cm, abanoonyereza baateesa okussaayo obwegendereza obusingako.
Baagamba nti abasawo balina okusooka okukendeeza ku kunyigiriza mu kifo ekiriko obuvune n’okuggya amazzi, era n’okuggya ebitundu byonna ebiri okumpi n’akamwa.
Eggumba liryoke likolebweko n’eddagala lya Carnoy.
Baateesa nti abasawo basaanye okukebera abalwadde bano buli myezi 2 okumala emyaka 2.
Bwe kiba nti omuntu alina ebizigiro bingi, abasawo bayinza okubikamulamu nga bakozesa ebikozesebwa ebikozesebwa mu malwaliro.
Kyokka mu ngeri yonna, okunoonyereza okwawuliddwa kwalaga nti emirundi egisinga, singa abasawo baggyawo ekituli ne bakozesa 5FU, abalwadde tebaddamu kufuna OKC.
Wabula baalabula nti obukakafu ku bujjanjabi buno tebutera kuba bwa maanyi bulijjo, era baazuula ebiwandiiko eby’obusobozi obutono ku nsonga eno.

Abanoonyereza era tebaakola bigezo byabwe bennyini okutegeeza ku bisembebwa bino; wabula, baagezaako okukungaanya engeri ezisinga obulungi ez’obujjanjabi okuva mu kunoonyereza okwakolebwa abanoonyereza abalala.
Abanoonyereza bano, abali mu ggwanga lya Nigeria ne USA, baateesa okunoonyereza okw’enjawulo mu mawanga amalala okusobola okukebera obuwanguzi bw’eddagala eriteeseddwa wano.
Era baayamba abasawo okulowooza ku mbeera endala z’abalwadde mu bujjanjabi.
Eddagala erigema erya SARS-CoV-2 (2019-nCoV), MERS-CoV ne SARSr-CoV: Okunoonyereza okw’enkola y’ebibalo okw’okugeraageranya okusobola okulaga epitope ezisobola okukozesebwa.

Akawuka ka kolona kasangibwa mu bika by’ensolo ng’abanywanyi, ebisolo ebirina omusaayi ogukalu oba ebinyonyi okusinziira ku kika kyabyo; naye, akawuka kano kasobola okukyusa omunywanyi olw’okufuukafuuka.
HCoV-229E lumu ku mawanga omukaaga g’akawuka ka kolona agakwata ku bantu nga mulimu HCoV-NL63, HCoV-OC43, HCoV-HKU1, MERS-CoV ne SARSr-CoV (SARSr-CoV-1 ne SARS-CoV2) era gasangibwa mu nsi yonna.
MERS-CoV ne SARS-CoV-2 bisobola okubeerawo ku bintu ebitali biramu nga (mabati, galasi oba pulasitiika okumala ennaku mwenda) (Huang, C.-L, 2020).

Enkola z’okwekuuma n’okujjanjaba n’eddagala lya hydrochloroquine birina akamanyi, naye eddagala erigema erikola obulungi liyinza okuba nga lyetaagibwa okusobola okukomya okusaasaana kwa nawookera wa covid-19.
Ekigendererwa ky’okunoonyereza kwaffe kwali kumanya epitope ezisobola okukozesebwa mu ddagala erigema nga tukozesa enkola ez’ebibalo kannabulamu.
Ebikozesebwa n’Obukodyo

Ensengeka z’endagabutonde ezijjuvu za SARS-CoV-2 zaafunibwa okuva mu 2019 Novel Coronavirus Resource (2019nCoVR) ne mu tterekero ebbiri, nga mulimu National Center for Biotechnology Information (NCBI) Global Initiative on Sharing All Inﬂuenza Data (GISAID) ne TAURAU/T-bio-infoserver ku byuma by’ebyobuwangwa obuli ku mutimbagano.

Tujja kuweereza akatambi akatono ku ntandikwa y’akawuka, tugenjula obubaka obw’enziriŋŋana okuzuula ebifo ebikuumibwa, ekitundu kye puloteyini ekisinga obungi (ekitundu ekiruubirirwa) n’okukola motif ey’okukkiriziganya ku moolekyu eyandiba ekirubirirwa (epitope) mu nteekateeka z’okujjanjaba akawuka aka 2019-nCoV, SARSr-CoV n’akawuka ka MERS-CoV akaakazuulibwa.
Ekyo kyewunyisa, okugeraageranya ensengeka wakati wa SARS-CoV-2 n’ekika ekirala kyayoleka nti ebisigalira ebiri mu nsonga ey’ekifunyi ekikola ku kwetooloola byakwekebwa nnyo n’obutafaanana bwa 70%.

Twasasula asidi akola puloteyini etaano ez’amaanyi (L455, Y473, N479, F486, Q493) ku kitundu ekifunyi ekikwatagana n’akawuka okuva mu puloteyini za spike ezikola ku kukwatagana wakati w’akawuka n’omubiri ogukwatibwa.
Mu SARS-CoV_ RBD mulimu ebisigalira (D480, ne T487) ebyakkiriza obuwuka okuyingira mu bika eby’enjawulo.
Naye, mu SARS-CoV-2, enkyukakyuka entonotono mu bisigalira ebimu kisobola okwongera ku nkolagana n’ekifunyi ky’ensigo z’omubiri gw’omuntu: L455, F486, Q493, ne N501.
Mu SARS-CoV, ebisigalira bibiri eby’omugaso (479 ne 487) byegattiddwa ku kumanya ekifunyi ekya ACE2 ky’omuntu.
Mu SARS-CoV-2, ebisigalira ebikwatagana ne N479 bikwatagana ne Q493 ate T487 ne N501.

Twasobola okuzuula ensengeka z’asidi akola puloteyini ezikuumibwa obulungi mu bika bingi by’akawuka ka kolona okuli ne 2019nCoV n’ebika ebirala, motif KRSFIEDLLFNKVTLADAGF yazuulibwa nga ekuumibwa obulungi nnyo mu kunoonyereza kuno era ng’ekwatagana n’ekitundu ekirina ku bifo ebimanyiddwa eby’okutemako eby’akawuka ka SARS ebikkirizibwa okuba nga byetaagibwa okuteekawo akawuka mu nkola y’okuyingira mu sselu.

Ensengeka eno motif n’enjawukana eziriranye zafuna obusisekwa bw’okuteekawo epitope y’eddagala erigemwa ery’ekikugu ekya synthetic, okuzuula kuno kisobola okukola ku moolekyu entonotono ezirina obukakafu obufaanana n’ezirina obusobyo n’ebitundu ebiruubirirwa.
Okunoonyereza kuno kuwa obubaka n’amasuubiriro ag’okukakasa eby’obulamu.

Omulimu guno kisobola okutegeerekeka mu ngeri y’obubaka obukwata ku by’obutonde, era ne gusobola okukoppebwa abalala mu ngeri eyangu, newankubadde obubaka obupya n’okunoonyereza ku Covid-19 bivaayo era ne bikula mu ngeri ey’amaanyi.
Bannassaayansi bageeraageranya COVID-19 n’obuwuka obulina enkolagana nabwo okusobola okuzuula eddagala erigema.

Mu Ssebutemba 2020, basayansi mu Mali baagerageranya obubaka obw’endagabutonde okuva mu kawuka ka Covid-19 ne kawuka ka kolona 2 agali kumpi ennyo okusobola okuzuula ebintu ebiyinza okuyamba mu kutumbula enkola y’eddagala eriziyiza.
Mu kiseera ekyo, bannassaayansi baali bakyakola okunoonya eddagala erigema eryatuukiridde ku COVID-19.
Baayagala okuzuula enkyukakyuka mu akawuka ka Covid-19 ezisobola okuba n’omugaso mu obuwuka.
Abanoonyereza ab’e Mali kyebaava bageerageranya akawuka ka Covid-19 (SARS-CoV-2) n’akawuka ka kolona kalala abiri agaleeta obulwadde mu bantu, nga MERS-CoV ne SARS-CoV.
